body:
Hey Peter, it's Jon Hamm.
#
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54925?refcode=em20240702-5917&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5917%2E614464%2EeejtYs)
Hey Peter, it’s Jon Hamm.
**There’s an important U.S. Senate race happening in my home state this year that I think you need to know about.**
So before I ask you to chip in toward my friend Lucas Kunce’s campaign to defeat Josh Hawley and flip Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat, please let me explain why no one can afford to sit on the sidelines in this race.
**[DEFEAT JOSH HAWLEY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/54925?refcode=em20240702-5917&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5917%2E614464%2EeejtYs)**
Let’s start at the beginning. When I first got to know Lucas, his story resonated with me. He’s a born-and-raised Missourian who knows the real value of community — helping each other out, for better or for worse.
Growing up, his parents went bankrupt from his youngest sister’s medical bills and his family survived on the support of their friends and neighbors. After getting to college on a Pell Grant, Lucas decided to join the U.S. Marine Corps to honor the community that had given his family so much. He served for 13 years, including three deployments to Iraq and Afghanistan before later being stationed at the Pentagon.

subject: You’ve picked me up when I needed your support
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Debbie for Florida
body:
You've always been there for me, friend
| | |
---
Friend, today, I’m reflecting on some of my earliest days in politics.

In the middle of such a consequential election season, it can be easy to lose sight of our very modest beginnings. **But for me, remembering where I came from, and the difficulties we have faced along the way is so important to appreciating all those who made it possible, and how much people are depending on me.**
Before my run for the U.S. Senate or my tenure in the U.S. House of Representatives was even a thought, I served as California State Senator from 1996 to 2000. While going through family photos with Eve, we stumbled across this one:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88139199/483272625/-1984759417?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1467-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjNmZDY1MmQtZDYzOC1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=Bji7OIF8dSSaHLf1CPkktSR_P9GOfr_ItGk2Qm4Lmn4=)
We were so young then! Eve has been my steadfast supporter since I told her I wanted to run for office. There’s someone else who’s been a constant since those early days, friend: **you.**
I lost my first race for the State Assembly. And my second. Only in my third race — this time for the State Senate — was I successful. No matter how big the challenge, this incredible team has helped us push forward. I haven’t walked any part of this path alone, and as Election Day gets closer, it’s a relief to know you’re by my side.
That said, friend, I’m asking for your support again today. **We’re just hours away from our crucial midnight fundraising deadline, and we’re falling behind.**
You’ve picked me up time and time again when fundraising deadlines were tight, and I’m confident we can make up the distance in no time. Your encouragement has helped me fight for abortion rights, advocate for climate change solutions, defend our democracy, and so much more. And again, I only have the privilege of doing this job because of _you._

Democratic Senate majority?

With all that’s at stake this election year, this race means a lot to so
many people across the country. This race means a lot to me, too.
Especially younger me.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=july2024_abs_em_blunt_rochester.m1Xe0t&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC90_20240702_PM2_V1_S1&t=1007&akid=6928%2E5257348%2EqaENAc ]Lisa Blunt Rochester as a child

I grew up knowing very few role models who looked like me in government,
so I made it my mission to change that. When I set my mind to something,
it gets done.

As I reflect, I can't help but look back at my younger self and think of
what helped me get here. It's the support from so many women — role
models, family members, friends, and so many more – who helped me feel
empowered to lead in Congress, and now run for Senate.

We need to continue to invest in women because when women are empowered,
the world is a better place. Our world, our power.

# Melton for Iowa 2024
---
---
| Hello Peter,

This is Ryan Melton, Democrat running for the U.S. House in Iowa's 4th Congressional District. During my 2024 campaign, I'll send you a weekly email to keep you in the loop while not overwhelming your inbox. Typically, the newsletter will be a review from the week prior: Where we went, what issues of note were on the minds of those I met with, where we'll be in the next week, etc.
Where I went on the campaign trail last week:

Last week, I: -door knocked and delivered signs in numerous Story County towns, -met with a crowd of 35 in Webster City in Hamilton County, -spoke with folks in State Center in Marshall County, Storm Lake in Buena Vista County, and Pocahontas in Pocahontas County, -attended the LULAC immigrant heritage festival and parade in Denison
The pressing issue on the campaign trail last week:
One of the big issues of the week last week was the Iowa Supreme Court's decision to lift the block on Gov. Reynolds six week abortion ban. The following is the statement I released in response:
"I live and am running for Congress in one of the most conservative congressional districts in the country. As such, I often speak with Iowans who call themselves "pro-life". Many such Iowans have told me Gov. Reynolds' abortion ban goes too far. They have told me stories of when they've lived here pre-Roe, having seen first hand what were called "red blanket cases," where pregnant woman died due to pregnancy complications when a medically-necessary abortion was not available. They have told me they are concerned because they know "pro-life" women are just as at risk of sexual violence, rape-related pregnancy, and pregnancy complications as everyone else.
Many of them have read the ban, and are shocked at the near impossibility of being granted a so-called "exception," and the forced outing and reporting of victims of sexual violence who are in situations where reporting puts them at immense risk for retaliation. Many also know we are last in the nation in OB-GYN availability rate, are seeing rural hospitals close, and know this draconian ban will amplify those concerns. We already have many counties in our 4th CD without a single OB-GYN, which is leading to an increase in infant and maternal mortality, and the data is clear that medical students in reproductive health are much less likely to practice in abortion ban states like ours.
To the many young women who have expressed their fear of getting pregnant in an abortion ban state: We mourn with you, we understand the urgency, and we will fight for you. Finally, our state is now added to the growing list of states that will see Kate Cox-like stories. We all have an obligation to protect our neighbors and our loved ones. Many don't keep up with the news and will not know of this ban until it's too late, so we must spread this news far and wide however we can."
Our schedule for this week:
-Thursday 7/4: The Ames Parade at 11, followed by the Story County Dems Picnic at 4:30 at Brookside Park. I am going to try to make it up to the Humboldt parade at 7 too. -Friday 7/5: Sioux City Parade in the evening -Saturday 7/6: Strategy/Planning Summit -Sunday 7/7: Strategy/Planning Cont.
Recent press/social media posts of note:

https://www.desmoinesregister.com/story/news/2024/06/28/iowa-supreme-court-lets-6-week-abortion-ban-take-effect-how-iowans-reacted-kim-reynolds/74205895007/
We again are rejecting all Corporate PAC money, so we really rely on, and are extremely grateful for your support. We'll spend your donations on ways to expand our reach to as many voters as possible, including:
-Post cards and other mailers and postage -Hand out cards for events -Text messaging campaigns -Transportation costs for events and door knocking -Campaign website costs -Radio ads, Social Media Ads, and (hopefully) TV ads -Our campaign staffers
Finally, if you have anyone else in mind that would like to be added to our email list or who would be interested in volunteering, let us know at melton4iowa@gmail.com!

clean_body: | | | | == | == | Melton for Iowa 2024 | Hello Peter, This is Ryan Melton, Democrat running for the U.S. House in Iowa's 4th Congressional District. During my 2024 campaign, I'll send you a weekly email to keep you in the loop while not overwhelming your inbox. Typically, the newsletter will be a review from the week prior: Where we went, what issues of note were on the minds of those I met with, where we'll be in the next week, etc. Where I went on the campaign trail last week: Last week, I: -door knocked and delivered signs in numerous Story County towns, -met with a crowd of 35 in Webster City in Hamilton County, -spoke with folks in State Center in Marshall County, Storm Lake in Buena Vista County, and Pocahontas in Pocahontas County, -attended the LULAC immigrant heritage festival and parade in Denison The pressing issue on the campaign trail last week: One of the big issues of the week last week was the Iowa Supreme Court's decision to lift the block on Gov. Reynolds six week abortion ban. The following is the statement I released in response: "I live and am running for Congress in one of the most conservative congressional districts in the country. As such, I often speak with Iowans who call themselves "pro-life". Many such Iowans have told me Gov. Reynolds' abortion ban goes too far. They have told me stories of when they've lived here pre-Roe, having seen first hand what were called "red blanket cases," where pregnant woman died due to pregnancy complications when a medically-necessary abortion was not available. They have told me they are concerned because they know "pro-life" women are just as at risk of sexual violence, rape-related pregnancy, and pregnancy complications as everyone else. Many of them have read the ban, and are shocked at the near impossibility of being granted a so-called "exception," and the forced outing and reporting of victims of sexual violence who are in situations where reporting puts them at immense risk for retaliation. Many also know we are last in the nation in OB-GYN availability rate, are seeing rural hospitals close, and know this draconian ban will amplify those concerns. We already have many counties in our 4th CD without a single OB-GYN, which is leading to an increase in infant and maternal mortality, and the data is clear that medical students in reproductive health are much less likely to practice in abortion ban states like ours. To the many young women who have expressed their fear of getting pregnant in an abortion ban state: We mourn with you, we understand the urgency, and we will fight for you. Finally, our state is now added to the growing list of states that will see Kate Cox-like stories. We all have an obligation to protect our neighbors and our loved ones. Many don't keep up with the news and will not know of this ban until it's too late, so we must spread this news far and wide however we can." Our schedule for this week: -Thursday 7/4: The Ames Parade at 11, followed by the Story County Dems Picnic at 4:30 at Brookside Park. I am going to try to make it up to the Humboldt parade at 7 too. -Friday 7/5: Sioux City Parade in the evening -Saturday 7/6: Strategy/Planning Summit -Sunday 7/7: Strategy/Planning Cont. Recent press/social media posts of note: We again are rejecting all Corporate PAC money, so we really rely on, and are extremely grateful for your support. We'll spend your donations on ways to expand our reach to as many voters as possible, including: -Post cards and other mailers and postage -Hand out cards for events -Text messaging campaigns -Transportation costs for events and door knocking -Campaign website costs -Radio ads, Social Media Ads, and (hopefully) TV ads -Our campaign staffers Finally, if you have anyone else in mind that would like to be added to our email list or who would be interested in volunteering, let us know at melton4iowa@gmail.com! Let's keep fighting the good fight together! Ryan Melton == | | | | | | | | == | == == == | == | P.O. name: Kerry McQuisten (Newsletter)
subject: Gearing up for Milwaukee!
body:
| | |
---
| |
---
_**L-R Top: Solomon Yue, Bruce Ash. L-R Middle: Mike Lee, RNC Convention Rules Committee '16. Bottom L-R: Harriet Hageman, Harmeet Dhillon, Chris Barreto and Solomon.**_
---
**Milwaukee, Here We Come!**
**PRESIDENTIAL POLITICS.**

In just a week, RNC members and 2024 convention committee members will fly out for those meetings. A weekend (also filled with meetings and events) sits in between, then 50,000 people will flood into Milwaukee, WI for the convention where President Trump will be officially nominated. Solomon and I have triple duty: the RNC, Republicans Overseas, and the Trump 47 Committee (not to be mistaken with Trump Force 47).

Convention committees like Rules and Platform are vital to the direction of both the party and how the convention itself plays out. I think most political junkies have probably heard rumors of threats to Trump's nomination process. I'm not worried. Yes, there have been members of a fringe alt-right faction chattering online about forcing their own VP choice onto Trump. That simply isn't going to happen. And yes, there are moderates within the RNC who have talked about parachuting in Nikki Haley by monkeying with the Rules the way they were monkeyed with in 2016. Solomon, Bruce Ash and Jim Bopp led the fight to protect Trump's nomination then - and they obviously won. From what I see, this year's Never-Trumpers are there, but they have little to no support. My guess is that the process will go smoothly. That's lucky.

In past conventions, state delegations from across the U.S. selected members for the convention committees largely based on experience and skills. Not so much this time. If you look at the photo collage above, it's filled with some of the conservative heavy-hitters who sided with Solomon and Bruce at every turn as they fought against the Never-Trumpers, RNC's own legal counsel on the floor, and even the RNC Chair's stance at that time during the RNC Convention Rules Meeting.

I saw a 2024 delegate elected to Rules write online what a "personal honor" it was to be on that committee. Therein lies the problem. These are _work_ assignments. They aren't intended to honor individuals. An extraordinary number of delegates on these crucial assignments this time around don't understand any of the process, don't know any RNC members or the dynamics between them, have never been to an RNC meeting ... I've heard about one who literally has never voted in any presidential election before. Ever.

This is kind of like grabbing a random guy off the sidewalk in front of the courthouse and telling him to come inside and be the defense attorney in a trial that's starting in half an hour!

Most of these Rules members will sit as silent observers because they aren't equipped to take the mic and fight like warriors at this level. The saving grace: those with experience foresaw the issue months ago and made sure enough of those heavy-hitters are still in place that if shenanigans are attempted, they'll be stopped. I also think the SCOTUS ruling this week regarding immunity has likely slapped the motivation right out of anyone thinking of introducing a rule to block the nomination from Trump using the "felon" excuse.

After Joe Biden's demented debate display, this entire convention is beginning to feel like a **celebration**!

**BAKER COUNTY REPUBLICAN WOMEN.**

Eastern Oregon and Idaho: Be sure and stop by the Baker County Republican Women's tent during Miners Jubilee! We'll have some unique merch, voter information and more. We're close to having enough money for our Patriot Kids Camp next year, and will have an announcement about a new way we're helping our community soon!

**CLOSING.**

I want to send my condolences out to the loved ones of David Darnell and Jeff Grossman, both well known in Oregon Republican Party circles. Both passed recently, as did another staunch conservative and Army veteran, my friend Terry Hughes from high school. This may be cliché ... but go out and live every day to the fullest, be grateful for every adventure - and try to do a little bit of good along the way.

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: another victory!!!
body:
All the pieces are falling into place in...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

You’ve heard media elites gleefully predicting that the abortion issue is going to DOOM Republicans this fall _(because they want you and me to give up and go home)._

But the truth is, it’s you and me who are winning!

In fact, I have an exciting update for you on some BIG WINS from the ongoing primary season at the state level, where the battle over abortion is currently being fought out!

While state legislative battles may not seem that exciting to some, this is how we save lives and advance the battle to abolish abortion by:

**>>>** Getting 100% pro-life champions elected to build towards a majority of U.S. states with STRONG abortion prevention laws;

**>>>** Building up the farm team of solid pro-life leaders who will continue to run for office and ensure the delegations sent from these pro-life states to Congress stand unapologetically for Life; and

**>>>** Using the state legislative majorities who know the Pro-Life Generation means business and will hold them accountable to their pro-life promises, pass strong legislation to protect every innocent preborn child.
## **[>>> DONATE<<< ](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gykqtl-duchtdja-y/)**
And just this past week, Iowa's Supreme Court upheld the state's six-week "Heartbeat" Abortion Prevention Law.

Pro-Life Friend, I cannot stress enough how much of a _**ROLL**_ _Students for Life Action_ and pro-life voters have been on at the state level recently, including in:

## **Oklahoma – June 18 th**
Weak-kneed Republican legislators in the Sooner State just learned the hard way that _Students for Life Action_ is watching them and expecting consistent pro-life votes.

After Senator Nathan Dahm forced a vote on a _Students for Life Action_ bill to end Chemical Abortion Pill Trafficking sponsored by Rep. Denise Crosswhite Hader, a majority of the caucus voted to kill our bill, refusing to take action to crack down on Chemical Abortions.

_And they paid for it big time._

On primary night, the voters we educated voiced their displeasure with this vote by throwing TWO leading pro-abortion Senators, Sen. Jessica Garvin and the Majority Leader Sen. Greg McCortney, out of office!

Additionally, they delivered resounding victories to Rep. Crosswhite Hader and her ally in the House, Rep. Jim Olsen.

Not only do these results mean that you and I will have the momentum in our efforts to stop Chemical Abortion from illegally being mailed into the state during the next session of the state legislature, but we sent a LOUD-AND-CLEAR message to legislators in other states that the same thing will happen to them if they get on the wrong side of the Pro-Life Generation!

## **[>>> DONATE<<< ](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gykqtl-duchtdja-j/)**
## **South Carolina – June 11 th**
During South Carolina’s Republican Primary, TWO of the THREE Republican women who betrayed pro-lifers by KILLING _Students for Life Action's "Life at Conception Act"_ LOST in their primaries!

_And the 3rd one was crushed at the polls in a runoff election last week!_

As you may recall, these three Republican women joined with Democrats to filibuster and kill the _Human Life Protection Act_ in South Carolina last year.

_The New York Times_ even wrote a gleaming article on them, dubbing them the “Sister Senators.”

These are the same pro-abortion Senators to whom our students delivered “Grow a Spine” awards to, insisting they show some backbone and stand up to _Planned Parenthood_ (and who responded by laughing and calling us names from the Senate floor).

But after the Palmetto State’s Republican Primary, one of them, Senator Penry Gustafson, was beaten very badly.

Another one, Senator Sandy Senn, lost by only 31 votes after _Students for Life Action’s_ Field Team knocked on 1,134 doors in her district!

And finally, Senator Katrina Shealy lost BADLY in a runoff election just a week ago – _barely even scrounging up one-third of the vote!_

_The Guardian_ subsequently reported, _“Complete Abortion Ban in South Carolina More Likely After Primaries.”_

With all three of these traitor Republicans GONE, we’ll have a real chance at finally passing our _Life at Conception Act_ in South Carolina in 2025 and save thousands of lives!

**So, who’s laughing now?**

## **[>>> DONATE<<< ](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gykqtl-duchtdja-i/)**
## **Kentucky – May 21 st**
Kentucky currently has pro-life laws protecting babies from abortion violence starting at conception.

But that doesn’t mean the Abortion Lobby isn’t still rabidly trying to take the state from under our feet! During the spring legislative session, we had to take a strong stance to stop some Republican legislators from ADDING in language into the state’s abortion ban law to allow abortions on some babies.

Thankfully, we won that battle, but I knew we had to target several key districts with voter education and our survey program before Kentucky’s recent state primaries.

We knocked doors in the Senate district where pro-life Rep. Steve Rawlings won, as well as the district where _Students for Life Action_ alumni Rep. TJ Roberts ran and won! Roberts was running against former Rep. Ed Massey, who had declared his support for giving taxpayer funding to organizations that commit abortions and for re-legalizing some abortions.

We were also actively knocking doors and sending texts and calls in the district of Rep. Killian Timoney, one of three Kentucky Republicans who sponsored the legislation that would've re-legalized some abortions. He was defeated!

## **[>>> DONATE<<< ](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gykqtl-duchtdja-d/)**
## **West Virginia – May 14 th**
In my original home state of West Virginia, _Students for Life Action_ was the main driver in helping pass the state’s _Life at Conception Act,_ right after _Roe_ was reversed.

Sadly, during that fight, the bill was watered down by some Republicans who aligned themselves with Democrats.

Fast-forward to Primary Day 2024, Senate President Craig Blair, who refused to allow any amendment votes to strengthen our bill – _and pushed other amendments to weaken the law_ – went down in DEFEAT!

One of these bad amendment sponsors was Senator Maroney, who was also DEFEATED by Senator Elect Chris Rose after _Students for Life Action_ conducted calls, texts, and mail in their districts.

We also defended our champion, Senator Patricia Rucker, who had been challenged by a “moderate” House member (Rep. Paul Espinosa) and won by fewer than 200 votes after _Students for Life Action_ canvassers knocked on over 1,200 doors!

## **[>>> DONATE<<< ](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gykqtl-duchtdja-h/)**
## **North Carolina – March 5 th**
While the Tar Heel state still currently allows all first-trimester abortions (over 95% of abortions) and continues to be a destination for abortion tourism, our team has been working consistently with Rep. Keith Kidwell to file the _Students for Life Action-_ inspired _North Carolina Human Life Protection Act._

North Carolina has a veto proof Republican majority, and there should be no reason why it cannot pass this full _Abortion Prevention Act_ this session – _if Republicans could be counted on to stand for Life._

Sadly, GOP leaders in the past few years have been reluctant to do anything on the abortion issue after passing a 12-Week Abortion Prevention Law last year.

_After the recent primaries, that may change!_

Thanks to our supporters, _Students for Life Action_ engaged in six targeted races in the March primary, educating voters about pro-life candidates who pledged to vote 100% pro-life and advance this key legislation.

Pro-lifers won four of the six, including:

**>** Ralph Carter, House District 48

**>** Jonathan Almond, House District 73

**>** Blair Eddins, House District 94

**>** Brian Echevarria, House District 82
Leading up to those primary elections, our organization sent 52,554 text messages, made 25,761 phone calls, and knocked 1,052 doors.

In Brian Echevarria’s district, the margin of victory was a mere 171 votes out of over 9,000 cast, showing the true impact that educating voters and door knockers can have!

Pro-Life Friend, these are the stories the media won’t tell you because they don’t want you to know the TRUTH.

**And the truth is, we’re winning.**

The Abortion Lobby is on the run.

Continuing to fight and demand that our state and federal legislators consistently protect preborn babies is critical to how successful we are at achieving our goal of finally abolishing abortion in America.

We can’t back down – _not with everything that’s at stake right now._

We have to be stronger than ever.

With your full support, I just know that I’ll be sharing some more MAJOR victories come November!

Thank you for everything you continue to do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

## **[>>> DONATE<<< ](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-gykqtl-duchtdja-k/)**

Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

Denise Crosswhite Hader, a majority of the caucus voted to kill our bill, refusing to take action to crack down on Chemical Abortions. And they paid for it big time. On primary night, the voters we educated voiced their displeasure with this vote by throwing TWO leading pro-abortion Senators, Sen. Jessica Garvin and the Majority Leader Sen. Greg McCortney, out of office! Additionally, they delivered resounding victories to Rep. Crosswhite Hader and her ally in the House, Rep. Jim Olsen. Not only do these results mean that you and I will have the momentum in our efforts to stop Chemical Abortion from illegally being mailed into the state during the next session of the state legislature, but we sent a LOUD-AND-CLEAR message to legislators in other states that the same thing will happen to them if they get on the wrong side of the Pro-Life Generation! South Carolina – June 11 th During South Carolina’s Republican Primary, TWO of the THREE Republican women who betrayed pro-lifers by KILLING Students for Life Action's "Life at Conception Act" LOST in their primaries! And the 3rd one was crushed at the polls in a runoff election last week! As you may recall, these three Republican women joined with Democrats to filibuster and kill the Human Life Protection Act in South Carolina last year. The New York Times even wrote a gleaming article on them, dubbing them the “Sister Senators.” These are the same pro-abortion Senators to whom our students delivered “Grow a Spine” awards to, insisting they show some backbone and stand up to Planned Parenthood (and who responded by laughing and calling us names from the Senate floor). But after the Palmetto State’s Republican Primary, one of them, Senator Penry Gustafson, was beaten very badly. Another one, Senator Sandy Senn, lost by only 31 votes after Students for Life Action’s Field Team knocked on 1,134 doors in her district! And finally, Senator Katrina Shealy lost BADLY in a runoff election just a week ago – barely even scrounging up one-third of the vote! The Guardian subsequently reported, “Complete Abortion Ban in South Carolina More Likely After Primaries.” With all three of these traitor Republicans GONE, we’ll have a real chance at finally passing our Life at Conception Act in South Carolina in 2025 and save thousands of lives! So, who’s laughing now? Kentucky – May 21 st Kentucky currently has pro-life laws protecting babies from abortion violence starting at conception. But that doesn’t mean the Abortion Lobby isn’t still rabidly trying to take the state from under our feet! During the spring legislative session, we had to take a strong stance to stop some Republican legislators from ADDING in language into the state’s abortion ban law to allow abortions on some babies. Thankfully, we won that battle, but I knew we had to target several key districts with voter education and our survey program before Kentucky’s recent state primaries. We knocked doors in the Senate district where pro-life Rep. Steve Rawlings won, as well as the district where Students for Life Action alumni Rep. TJ Roberts ran and won! Roberts was running against former Rep. Ed Massey, who had declared his support for giving taxpayer funding to organizations that commit abortions and for re-legalizing some abortions. We were also actively knocking doors and sending texts and calls in the district of Rep. Killian Timoney, one of three Kentucky Republicans who sponsored the legislation that would've re-legalized some abortions. He was defeated! West Virginia – May 14 th In my original home state of West Virginia, Students for Life Action was the main driver in helping pass the state’s Life at Conception Act, right after Roe was reversed. Sadly, during that fight, the bill was watered down by some Republicans who aligned themselves with Democrats. Fast-forward to Primary Day 2024, Senate President Craig Blair, who refused to allow any amendment votes to strengthen our bill – and pushed other amendments to weaken the law – went down in DEFEAT! One of these bad amendment sponsors was Senator Maroney, who was also DEFEATED by Senator Elect Chris Rose after Students for Life Action conducted calls, texts, and mail in their districts. We also defended our champion, Senator Patricia Rucker, who had been challenged by a “moderate” House member (Rep. Paul Espinosa) and won by fewer than 200 votes after Students for Life Action canvassers knocked on over 1,200 doors! North Carolina – March 5 th While the Tar Heel state still currently allows all first-trimester abortions (over 95% of abortions) and continues to be a destination for abortion tourism, our team has been working consistently with Rep. Keith Kidwell to file the Students for Life Action- inspired North Carolina Human Life Protection Act. North Carolina has a veto proof Republican majority, and there should be no reason why it cannot pass this full Abortion Prevention Act this session – if Republicans could be counted on to stand for Life. Sadly, GOP leaders in the past few years have been reluctant to do anything on the abortion issue after passing a 12-Week Abortion Prevention Law last year. After the recent primaries, that may change! Thanks to our supporters, Students for Life Action engaged in six targeted races in the March primary, educating voters about pro-life candidates who pledged to vote 100% pro-life and advance this key legislation. Pro-lifers won four of the six, including: Ralph Carter, House District 48 Jonathan Almond, House District 73 Blair Eddins, House District 94 Brian Echevarria, House District 82 Leading up to those primary elections, our organization sent 52,554 text messages, made 25,761 phone calls, and knocked 1,052 doors. In Brian Echevarria’s district, the margin of victory was a mere 171 votes out of over 9,000 cast, showing the true impact that educating voters and door knockers can have! Pro-Life Friend, these are the stories the media won’t tell you because they don’t want you to know the TRUTH. And the truth is, we’re winning. The Abortion Lobby is on the run. Continuing to fight and demand that our state and federal legislators consistently protect preborn babies is critical to how successful we are at achieving our goal of finally abolishing abortion in America. We can’t back down – not with everything that’s at stake right now. We have to be stronger than ever. With your full support, I just know that I’ll be sharing some more MAJOR victories come November! | Friends, Today, Senator John McGuire was confirmed by the Virginia State Board of Election to be the Republican nominee for Congress in District 5, currently held by Congressman Bob Good. As such, this leaves open the Virginia Senate Seat in State Senate District 10, which encompasses Amelia, Appomattox, Buckingham, Cumberland, part of Prince Edward, Goochland, Hanover, Louisa, Powhatan and Fluvanna. It is this seat that I will be seeking so that I can once again represent you in the Virginia Senate as the strong conservative that you've come to rely on and trust for the past 8 years.
Currently, I have a contract pending on a home in Appomattox and will reside in Senate District 10 by the end of the month. From 2016 to 2023, I represented Amelia County and ran for Governor in 2021, so I'm quite familiar with the 10th District.
We need to return a true conservative that you can trust to the Virginia Senate. I have an 8 year perfect 100 percent voting record that proves I'm pro-gun, pro-life, pro-school choice, pro-God, pro-election integrity and have voted again all tax increases and regulation for 8 years.
Today, I humbly ask for your support as I seek the Republican nomination for Senate District 10. Please send me back to the Virginia Senate so that I can continue to be your conservative voice.
Please show your support and give your best donation today so that I can continue to be your conservative voice and represent you in the Virginia Senate.

This is a deeply personal email, but I want to tell you why it's critical for us to take back our culture and education from the radical left... not just in sports, but even in children's books.

My story begins at the University of Kentucky. I was on the swim team. I am a 12-time NCAA all-American, 5x SEC champion, and SEC record holder in the butterfly.

But then it all changed for a photo-opt.

In March of 2022, I and other female swimmers were forced to compete with a male, Lia Thomas. We watched as this male swam to a title, beating out Olympians and other record holders. Despite tying Lia to the 100th of a second, the NCAA denied me the trophy because the NCAA claimed it was necessary to have Lia Thomas hold the trophy while photos were being taken.

The radical left reduced everything I worked my entire life for down to a photo opt.

But that's not all...

I was forced to share locker rooms with a 6'4" man.

**_This is where the madness needs to end because it 's not just sports where the radical gender ideology movement is dominating_.**

Now, children's literature is injected with this radical gender ideology movement.

[You can help me STOP this madness by making an urgent donation to SkyTree Book Fairs, which is combating Scholastic's transgender woke propaganda, by creating a wholesome and age-appropriate book fair alternative for parents, students, and educators. Some of the books are too gross to even share with you on this email. But here are pages from "Welcome to St. Hell," a 2022 Scholastic book glamorizing gender transitioning to middle schoolers.
[](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=84a1bd05f15f4bca904566a80c21da3b&_e=1reoFtck2TP7tJVS9cbFo997QOJuO3L6H7O7nXS45qJMDUsZebvNpSfRP8OAvJsLuyQLydmt7FJGyvt7Rre1hov3VPyG17X1upaBr1rNPixrV7hFLgt6FrnmOmg8s5gTH_wESZ-zQBmIQKLHT3PntgYYdqj5yS16jnbjqKD6DZf-g0AgHrfKi_5QikgP-6nBbdi-Yw2IR59W_AFLdIqRiMt0zUt1awM4xWOOJIMy2Qe3Xpq65H6RZ-vF5xSl3HzZ3rLKX4ydsRiXzxCAJqnyqfOmOdic-iGZikJyMdVd6jhKIb7RsA0jaSyGNSP7U8N8aJB_urk7RW7_ACv1QpiTWL3Hz28KWZ7uJZfjXZ41Hg4%3D)
Full stop: This needs to end. No compromising. No more excuses.

While Scholastic holds a virtual monopoly on school book fairs, one organization is fighting back, and I am urgently asking for you to support them as you have supported my fight to defend women's sports.

SkyTree Book Fair offers schools a different option for book fairs. SkyTree Book Fairs is providing schools, parents, and children with an empowering alternative with literature rooted in truth and family values that matches the quality and ease of Scholastic while countering their harmful agenda.

You may remember Scholastic book fairs. All the kids used to love it when they came to school. It was a catalog of all the stories I got to read. It used to be an innocent event.

Unfortunately, that's all changed.

Scholastic now promotes woke, radical LGBT books. They promote a radical agenda over the well-being of kids.

name: No Dem Left Behind
subject: The Power of Rural Democrats
body:
Local parties are coming together like never before to build a rural resurgence.
| | | | | |
---
# Rural Democrats Are Being Heard.
---
|
---
The pandemic changed so much for so many Americans. There are a few silver linings amongst those clouds. The world learned how to be more digitally connected and connected across great distances. Rural America is all about great distances. For years, political organizing was an insurmountable challenge in certain districts. Upon No Dem Left Behind's founding, we recognized that obstacle and had a plan to address it. Our early virtual town halls utilized celebrity star-power to spotlight Dems in deep-red districts. Our ROCC forums taught the principles of organizing in a peer-learning environment. Our work on ARPA inspired activism in Republican-led counties. In short, our mission was to connect and empower rural Democrats to build the infrastructure to reshape the Electoral Map in the years to come.
---
|
---
The lesson? After the rain, comes flowers.
---
|
---
It's a pleasure to have you with us in this ongoing journey. And that's how rural Democrats are feeling. Our reward at No Dem Left Behind comes when we step into that local Dems meeting, when we partner and accomplish something together, we get that great, big "thank you". Thanks for recognizing us, remembering us, and making sure we never feel left behind. If you can spare a little to support this work, we'd greatly appreciate it...
---

To tomorrow's field of flowers. — No Dem Left Behind

A few years ago, members of the world's elite met at the annual World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, and launched the Great Reset initiative.

What is their plan, and what does it mean for America?

In short, they aim to transform the world economy. As Klaus Schwab--the founder and executive director of the Forum--wrote, "We need a 'Great Reset' of capitalism." If successful, their plan would also have the effect of destroying our American way of life.

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we can communicate directly with you.

In this seminar, we...
* Consider the idea of the Great Reset and its implications for America.
* Explore how the ideology of "woke capitalism" is infiltrating large corporations.

Friend -- **Happy Fourth of July!** I have written the statement below for mass distribution at parades and festivals across the state and nation. Please print copies and take them everywhere you are going this week. If you want to join organized Sare for Senate rallies, please call 646-328-1932, or reply to this email. [Click here for PDF in English and Spanish](https://www.sareforsenate.com/independence_day_2024_pdf?e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_july_4_meeage&n=2).[](https://www.sareforsenate.com/r?u=2PNlHEbVYFsh-F_FzIY8nZ-J75eJo-uYzrnUVrrn2kE&e=bd1d687cdeff164927fc1e159dca3e71&utm_source=sareforsenate&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2024_july_4_meeage&n=3)
##
## Independence Day 2024: What is America Doing for Mankind?
June 30, 2024—On July 4, 1821, the 45th anniversary of the Declaration of Independence, in answer to the question, “What has America done for the benefit of mankind?” then-Secretary of State John Quincy Adams replied: _America, with the same voice which spoke herself into existence as a nation, proclaimed to mankind the inextinguishable rights of human nature and the only lawful foundations of government...She has, in the lapse of nearly half a century, without a single exception, respected the independence of other nations while asserting and maintaining her own...Wherever the standard of freedom and Independence has been or shall be unfurled, there will her heart, her benedictions and her prayers be. But she goes not abroad, in search of monsters to destroy. She is the well-wisher to the freedom and independence of all. She is the champion and vindicator only of her own..._ How tragic that we cannot say the same today about our actions over the last century! Our nation has taken on the hue of our former oppressor, and become that which our founders abhorred. What would John Quincy Adams have had to say about the war in Vietnam, the overthrow of Iraq’s Saddam Hussein, and the brutal murder of Libya’s Gaddafi? Would Adams have endorsed our shipping billions of dollars worth of weapons to Ukraine and Israel which has led to the deaths of hundreds of thousands of people, including thousands of children, with no benefit to anyone, merely to inflate the egos and bank accounts of a few despots? Not only has our participation in these wars abroad brought horrors upon the people suffering through them, but it is also destroying the very fabric of our own nation. In the same speech as quoted above, Adams said of America, _“She well knows that by once enlisting under other banners than her own... The fundamental maxims of her policy would insensibly change from liberty to force.... She might become the dictatress of the world: she would be no longer the ruler of her own spirit.”_ Nowhere was this loss of spirit more evident than in the recent presidential debate between Biden and Trump! The questions were generally stupid, and the responses low-level or outright lies, with the current president displaying for the world what has been obvious for years: he is in no shape, physically or mentally, to be leading the United States at this very moment, let alone in the future. And so it appears that Adams’ forecast was correct, America is no longer the “ruler of her own spirit.” Do not look to the current crop of mediocre or catastrophic presidential candidates for the remedy. The remedy lies within each of us. It lies within the opening phrase of our beloved Constitution, “We the People...” It is time for “We the People” to stop participating in our own oppression, which is always the result of tolerating or perpetrating evil done to others. As the great poet (and follower of the American Revolution) Friedrich Schiller understood, nothing is so destructive of the nature of man than to attempt to subvert the will through force or violence. This is why Adams warned “liberty” would be replaced by “force,” as when attempting to enforce arbitrary rules which go against the laws of nature. Were we not temporarily blinded by our own subservience to insanity, we would recognize that the spark of liberty kindled by the American Revolution has caught fire in the global south, with nation after nation leaving the colonial system and joining with Brazil, Russia, India, China, South Africa (BRICS) to chart a course for their own independence, each in their own fashion, but guided by the common interests of mankind. We should not be trying to crush this revival of our own revolutionary mission, but collaborating in its progress. The billions of people in Africa, Asia and Ibero-America who are finally seizing control of their own destiny, have no interest in destroying the United States, and they take no pleasure in seeing us destroy ourselves. Nothing would bring greater happiness to billions of people than a United States returned to the spirit of our own Declaration of Independence, which would be demonstrated by turning our vast, but morally and actually bankrupt, industrial capacity from producing weapons of mass destruction to producing the technology and infrastructure we need to increase man’s power over nature, not only eradicating poverty here and abroad, but joining the initiative of China and Russia to industrialize the moon and beyond. This is what John Quincy Adams would have expected of America in 2024. This is why I am asking you to support my campaign to represent you in the United States Senate.

| Now, let’s get into some details. There’s an inverse relationship between turnout and the impact of campaigning. The less people paying attention, the more impact per unit of additional work. Take local elections. When nobody has heard of their City Council member, they don’t feel like they know the issues, and they don’t vote. BUT that means that a city council candidate can win her race just by knocking on doors after work. Each knock is more likely to move a voter. And each voter is more likely to tip the election. The impact per unit of work is higher. Which takes us to 2024. Presidential elections are the highest-salience elections, by far. But turnout in presidential years varies a lot from cycle to cycle. And this year, an unusually large number of people aren’t tuning in yet. What’s more, there’s a strong correlation between “paying attention” and “supporting Biden.” In fact, polls say that among Democrats, the people paying the least attention to the news are the ones whose support is in question. This is what campaigning is for, Peter: informing voters. And in this election, we have a unique opportunity to inform, persuade, and move voters to join the fight for decency and democracy. But only with your help. When you donate to WisDems, your dollars help us expand our reach – even more so because so many voters aren’t fully tuned in yet. Wisconsin could tip the whole national presidential election – and the margin here could be a few thousand votes. Which means a little can go a long way. That's why staying on track towards our fundraising targets is more important than ever. body:
Should you find yourself renovating your bathroom anytime soon, be on the lookout for something strange: razor blades, which used to be tossed into holes in the bathroom wall. # [Razor blades used to be disposed of in holes in bathroom walls.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sg1nxm&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [Arts & Culture](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sg1nxm&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sg1nxm&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| S hould you find yourself renovating your bathroom anytime soon, be on the lookout for something strange: razor blades, which used to be tossed into holes in the bathroom wall. Depending on when your home was built, you might even still have one of these (vaguely terrifying) slots either in your medicine cabinet or the wall above your sink. They were [fairly common ](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sg1nxm&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)in the early 20th century, when disposable blades first became widely available. Disposable razors made it safer and easier to shave at home, but problems arose when it came to actually disposing of the blades: Razor blades are sharp, not to mention potential biohazards, and simply tossing them in the trash ran the risk of accidentally nicking yourself with a used blade.
---
Enter the bathroom wall solution, which essentially delayed the problem by years or decades and passed the burden on to someone else. The question of razor blade disposal became less of an issue once better, more durable razors were introduced to the market, especially the kind you throw away entirely, handle and all. Thanks to these innovations, homes built in the 1970s or later are unlikely to include a disposal slot — which, unless you’d like to be greeted by hundreds of rusty blades when you knock down your bathroom wall, can only be a good thing.

## Shaving doesn’t cause hair to grow back thicker.
You’ve probably heard this common misconception many times, but it’s just that: a myth. The reason it persists is because the stubble left behind after shaving tends to be blunt at the end, making it appear thicker (or even darker) even though it isn’t. If hair really did grow back thicker, everyone who’s shaved consistently throughout their life would have increasingly luscious locks — a fun thing to imagine, perhaps, but not a scientific reality.

clean_body: Should you find yourself renovating your bathroom anytime soon, be on the lookout for something strange: razor blades, which used to be tossed into holes in the bathroom wall. | S hould you find yourself renovating your bathroom anytime soon, be on the lookout for something strange: razor blades, which used to be tossed into holes in the bathroom wall. Depending on when your home was built, you might even still have one of these (vaguely terrifying) slots either in your medicine cabinet or the wall above your sink. They were the early 20th century, when disposable blades first became widely available. Disposable razors made it safer and easier to shave at home, but problems arose when it came to actually disposing of the blades: Razor blades are sharp, not to mention potential biohazards, and simply tossing them in the trash ran the risk of accidentally nicking yourself with a used blade. Enter the bathroom wall solution, which essentially delayed the problem by years or decades and passed the burden on to someone else. The question of razor blade disposal became less of an issue once better, more durable razors were introduced to the market, especially the kind you throw away entirely, handle and all. Thanks to these innovations, homes built in the 1970s or later are unlikely to include a disposal slot — which, unless you’d like to be greeted by hundreds of rusty blades when you knock down your bathroom wall, can only be a good thing. | Thank you for supporting our advertisers! | By the Numbers | | Year the first razor with disposable blades was sold 1903 | | Patent number of the first disposable razor 775,134 | Patent number of the first disposable razor 775,134 | | Disposable razor blades sold in 1904 2 million | | Blades on the Dorco Pace 7, the most of any disposable razor 7 | Blades on the Dorco Pace 7, the most of any disposable razor 7 | | | Did you know? ---|---|--- Shaving doesn’t cause hair to grow back thicker. You’ve probably heard this common misconception many times, but it’s just that: a myth. The reason it persists is because the stubble left behind after shaving tends to be blunt at the end, making it appear thicker (or even darker) even though it isn’t. If hair really did grow back thicker, everyone who’s shaved consistently throughout their life would have increasingly luscious locks — a fun thing to imagine, perhaps, but not a scientific reality. Dear Peter,
As President, I will be relentless in my fight against corporate dominance in our politics.
Here’s why: Big Oil, Big Tech, Big Pharma, and military contractors fund both sides of the political aisle, merging their interests with those of our politicians—but not with ours.
When these corporate giants face opposition, their lobbyists and lawyers fight fiercely to silence it. They either bulldoze over dissent or buy it off.
But they haven't bulldozed me. I've taken them on and WON, and I won't stop now.
For 40 years, I've been battling corporate corruption. I've seen how these companies operate, I know their tactics, and I've successfully fought to clean them up. They hate that they can't buy my silence or my loyalty.
That's why Big Pharma and military contractors especially dislike me—it disrupts their control.
I am driven by compassion and a profound belief in our nation can once again stand as a moral leader in the world.
I am here to serve you—to ensure our government does what is best for the American people, not for corporate balance sheets.
It's clear our system doesn’t just need tweaking; it needs a complete overhaul.
* Install Honest Leadership: We will place honest, competent leaders throughout the federal bureaucracy, transforming each agency to serve the national interest, not corporate interests.
* Root Out Corruption: We will replace corporate-friendly agency leaders with dedicated reformers and whistleblowers who are committed to transparency and accountability.
* Close the Revolving Door: By executive order, I will impose a five-year ban preventing administration officials from lobbying their former government agencies after they leave public service.
* Enhance Transparency: We will make government agencies transparent to public scrutiny, ensuring that the American people can trust that their government is working for them, not big corporations.

I believe that we can make the dream of a stronger, more prosperous, and more united America a reality—a nation that is of, by, and for the people, not controlled by corporations.
[Let’s take this journey together to reclaim our country and restore the voice of the American people in our government.](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate-corporate-capture?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=reclaim_america_7_3_24_rs_nd1&n=5)

Robert F. Kennedy Jr.

Let's recap, fellow patriot...

- I’m the America First conservative and political outsider running to defeat 50-year career politician Shady Sherrod Brown in \*\*Ohio’s toss-up U.S. Senate race.\*\*

-

\*\*President Donald Trump won Ohio in 2016 and 2020\*\* , making it one of our best chances to flip a seat red in 2024.

- Democrats have a 2-seat majority, which means \*\*we MUST flip Ohio\*\* in order to restore a Republican majority that can work with a Trump White House to get our country back on track.

-

\*\*President Trump has endorsed my campaign\*\* , and it’s been my privilege to campaign alongside him.

- The latest polls show Brown with a \*\*5% lead\*\* , just outside the margin of error.

- Brown is also leading \*\*ALL U.S. SENATE CANDIDATES\*\* in fundraising, making ours one of the biggest challenges to overcome.

I hope you understand _ \*\*we have no choice\*\* _ but to win this seat in Ohio. _But I’m behind_ – both in polling and fundraising.

I can’t win in Ohio unless I receive the same support _(or more)_ from you and our conservative grassroots base that Sherrod Brown is from his leftist base.

Thankfully, we still have time to catch up. _But it’s going to take all of us pulling together!_

\*\*Please show your commitment to delivering a Republican Senate majority for President Trump in 2024 by following his lead and sending support to our campaign.\*\*

\*\*Your $500, $50, or even $5 contribution will truly make an impact in a competitive race where every edge will be needed to win.\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=14101592.5752.1.c96e200e18570115018c2ca1609fdc8c )

\*\*Meet Bernie Moreno:\*\*

( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=14101592.5755.1.62f50487748a10589c071acaac39451e ) Bernie Moreno fights for the American Dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18.

Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America.

In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board.

After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation.

Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First.

Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has.

body:

---
| | | |
---
| | | | Dear Friends and Colleagues,

With Honor Action co-hosted a standing room-only event with Exiger and POLITICO Live last week that focused on securing America’s supply chain for our critical infrastructure with For Country Caucus Vice-Chair Rep. Mikie Sherrill and Rep. Jake Ellzey. With Honor Action and the bipartisan veterans we work with in Congress are shaping legislation to make our supply chain more resilient, especially in light of vulnerabilities with the CCP. Rep. Sherrill also serves on the Select Committee on the CCP, and Rep. Ellzey is a member of the Defense Appropriations Subcommittee.

You can listen to the opening remarks and panels at this [Politico Live link](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=2d368e68bc&e=33f53a5b1a).
---
|
---
| Last month the NDAA passed the U.S. House and is now being worked on in the Senate. We work alongside six bipartisan veterans in the Senate and are focused on a number of critical items to pass in this year's NDAA that range from supply chain resilience to AI and cybersecurity provisions, democracy assistance abroad, support for Afghan and Ukrainian allies, improved mental healthcare, and a package of laws led by For Country Caucus founding leaders Rep. Chrissy Houlahan and Rep. Don Bacon to improve military quality of life and mitigate military food insecurity.

Finally, we wanted to share with you a superb [article](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=2769325842&e=33f53a5b1a) highlighting Army veteran and former With Honor Advisory Board member, Maryland Governor Wes Moore. Wes continues to rise as an important and inspiring voice of our post 9-11 veteran generation on the national stage. We will be co-hosting an event with him in August, and participating in both national conventions later this summer.

We hope you and your family have a great and safe Independence Day weekend.

# **TOP NEWS**

**TRUMP DOMINATES FUNDRAISING –** President Donald Trump is crushing Crooked Joe Biden in fundraising just like he crushed Biden in the debate. Yesterday, the Trump Campaign reported that in the second quarter of fundraising, **_it raised a total of $331 million_**._**This beats the quarterly number of $264 million reported by Biden for the same period.**_ After beating Biden in the months of April and May, the Trump team added another $111.8 million in June.
More importantly, the Trump campaign ends June with a cash on hand advantage as Biden continues to burn through millions while still losing ground in national and battleground polling. Team Trump’s cash on hand at the end of June is $284.9 million compared to $240 million reported by Biden. Make America Great Again!
[](https://link.deskofdonaldjtrump.)
|
---
**NEARLY $120 MILLION UP IN FLAMES –** Joe Biden has spent nearly $120 million trying to deny reality, and it hasn’t moved the polls an inch. Even worse than that for Joe Biden – all of that spending on lies and gaslighting was flushed down the toilet in 90 minutes. **** Here’s a rundown of the recent polls:
* [CNN](https://link.deskofdonaldjtrump.): President Trump leads Biden by 6 points.
* [Harvard/Harris](https://link.deskofdonaldjtrump.): President Trump leads Biden by 8 points in a five way race.
* [USA Today/Suffolk](https://link.deskofdonaldjtrump.): President Trump leads Biden by 3 points in a five way race.****
* [St. Anselm](https://link.deskofdonaldjtrump.): President Trump leads Biden by 2 points in New Hampshire, which hasn’t voted for a Republican presidential candidate in 24 years.
* [Cygnal](https://link.deskofdonaldjtrump.): President Trump leads Biden by 4 points in Pennsylvania.
* [EPIC-MRA](https://link.deskofdonaldjtrump.): President Trump leads Biden by 4 points in Michigan

In the words of Trump Campaign Senior Advisors Chris LaCivita and Susie Wiles: _“President Trump’s campaign fundraising operation is thriving day after day and month after month. Winning this quarter brought us a cash on hand advantage, which is punctuated by a Biden burn rate that grows while yielding no tangible results for them. Despite Biden spending nearly $120 million on tv, cable and radio alone, polling and voter enthusiasm continue to grow for President Trump. This fundraising momentum is likely to grow even more as we head into a world-class convention and see the Democrats continue their circular firing squad in the aftermath of Biden’s debate collapse.”_
The main problem Biden faces is reality. **_The reality is that Biden is a failed, dishonest, and weak president who is unfit for office._**

**Democrats want to lift us.** Sherrod Brown and his fellow Senate Democrats work every day to solve the problems that keep their constituents up at night.

[**So please, will you use your grassroots power and contribute right now to reelect Sherrod Brown? Your donation of $5 or $25 is essential to ensure Sherrod’s victory and keep the Senate blue.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88163823/483330605/-1893289703?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk2140-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2N2RkOWMzYi00NTM5LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dz4EJ-kAwOHl3Oetlr_VD7mjYcdwQMu8c8qwBB2lrYU=)

I’m doing my part – and I thank you for doing yours.
Wishing you and your family all the best.

– Carole

clean_body: Our campaign has come a LONG way | | | = Thank you so much for all your support and for standing with me in my fight to flip Florida blue, friend. I can't even begin to express how much your commitment means to me, but I can tell you right now — none of this would be remotely possible without you. Our campaign has come a LONG way, but here's where it all started: At 14, I left my home in Ecuador with my mom and sisters in search of a better life. I went from making minimum wage at a local doughnut shop to being the first South American immigrant to be elected to Congress. That, my friend, is the American dream. But it didn't come easy. I had to work hard and fight to get where I am today. And that's why I relate to the hardworking families all across the U.S. I've spent my life in public service fighting to expand opportunities for every single American, from making health care affordable to advocating for gun violence prevention and reproductive freedom. = Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue. | | | = | | = | | = | | = With gratitude, Debbie | * | | | = Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is a Floridian, South American immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. She’s dedicated her life to uplifting working families, ending gun violence, and fighting for her community. Now, she’s running to defeat Republican Senator Rick Scott and win a better, brighter future for Florida.

I am writing to you today as a dedicated advocate for our nation's veterans and as someone who is committed to addressing the critical issues faced by our service members.

**At this pivotal time, we need leaders who will honor their promises to those who have bravely served our country.**

Americans who serve and make the greatest sacrifice deserve the highest levels of respect and gratitude. Sadly, it has been a struggle for too many to receive even basic services. I am committed to improving the lives of veterans, including:

**Healthcare Access:** Ensuring that veterans have timely access to high-quality healthcare, both through the VA system and in private facilities when necessary.

** Mental Health Services:** Expanding mental health services for veterans, including support for those suffering from PTSD, depression, and other service-related conditions.

**Homelessness Prevention:** Implementing robust programs to address and prevent veteran homelessness, ensuring that no veteran is left without a safe place to call home.

To continue this vital work, I need your support. Campaigns are costly, and resources are necessary to achieve victory in November.

[Even a $5 donation today](https://lizjohnsonforus.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d4a0fd0913238344008dfe952&id=f3cc825c3a&e=e8eaba4639) will make a significant impact. It will help us amplify our voice and ensure that the needs of our service members are prioritized in government policy.

# Every contribution, no matter the size, brings us closer to a future where veterans receive the respect, care, and support they deserve.

Thank you for your time, your dedication to veterans' issues. Together, we can make a real difference.

Liz

Dear Patriot,

_When New Yorkers hired me to represent them for the second time, I made a promise to the American people._

I promised to work tirelessly to undo the harmful policies plaguing New York and implement new ones to create a safer city full of opportunity.

**[With your help,](http://links.nicolemalliotakis.com/u/click?_t=759a85d1cba743719e64e2569e23c9b8&_m=e2d75e6d32634acaaad18a907544ede6&_e=jQ5NVrl3KlBSU8HwFQZRUOZKSwm8fFI5YVlyO0_6wYZPALcLgXxyoWws00cQ9gr49o3oSdAHYI0qkNf0gVBoZUTMrddIIcGJeKxS-UBauq8f5fDeoyxc4CnO5PrcAwmkM6m2pOr4c3QvwKt8ogBqErRas1pIPyoAQpcCkO6SoWn_00nHMnhaHf2k-YTRz5LatofO1c4h_Z0c9T266GPCWkBCazqzUNqQg30MMHjSd4L0t_tYR7Qsh12eA_BCzLgrzZn4JratsCH4m2NJsEYU8SimJeb1m_ZXOM42wrgZvXM6Bfjg5l2rgTtIiXcCl56VqDo4Chajv5sQezqrktJISw%3D%3D)** we have made great strides towards completing this goal. Restoring New York to its glory days is no easy feat, but:

********
* **We led the initiative to reopen New York City 's schools during the pandemic and keep specialized high schools open.

**
* **We 've equipped nearly every school with a trained police officer and security equipment to protect our students.

**
* **We 're the leading plaintiffs in the lawsuit to stop New York City from allowing non-citizens to vote in our municipal elections.

**
* **We 've opposed sanctuary city policies while helping law-abiding New Yorkers become American citizens.

**
* **We defeated Joe Biden 's $3.5 trillion socialist Build Back Better socialist spending plan.**

* **We are the leading voices in the fight against the Biden Administration 's plan to close the Brooklyn Veterans Affairs hospital. **

| [ **STAND WITH CONGRESSWOMAN MALLIOTAKIS** ](http://links.nicolemalliotakis.com/u/click?_t=759a85d1cba743719e64e2569e23c9b8&_m=e2d75e6d32634acaaad18a907544ede6&_e=jQ5NVrl3KlBSU8HwFQZRUOZKSwm8fFI5YVlyO0_6wYZPALcLgXxyoWws00cQ9gr49o3oSdAHYI0qkNf0gVBoZUTMrddIIcGJeKxS-UBauq8f5fDeoyxc4CnO5PrcAwmkM6m2pOr4c3QvwKt8ogBqErRas1pIPyoAQpcCkO6SoWn_00nHMnhaHf2k-YTRz5LaObk9_ZOLlqLlOLGYHrgpuvE4ReA6ypSPNgY3r5oCKi8A-6BDUf8BuW8c5lANB5Qg0CfxA_39fjB4CC3rykNwcnkqci8syjig8tPCE_jUNfM1TZGhuaCWJ51zgWCtyjUxq_vkusupNT7DYcf4gelEpQ%3D%3D)
---

We achieved all of this together, not driven by a partisan agenda, but because we understand that practical solutions produce the best outcomes for New York City.

**[However, the progress we've made is now at risk due to the influence of far-left Democrats who have continually gained power in Congress.](http://links.nicolemalliotakis.com/u/click?_t=759a85d1cba743719e64e2569e23c9b8&_m=e2d75e6d32634acaaad18a907544ede6&_e=jQ5NVrl3KlBSU8HwFQZRUOZKSwm8fFI5YVlyO0_6wYZPALcLgXxyoWws00cQ9gr49o3oSdAHYI0qkNf0gVBoZUTMrddIIcGJeKxS-UBauq8f5fDeoyxc4CnO5PrcAwmkM6m2pOr4c3QvwKt8ogBqErRas1pIPyoAQpcCkO6SoWn_00nHMnhaHf2k-YTRz5LaKFR_NFnCumBALG4hQudADeML6htIaCxR-yj00yVQ_fL0lyVMS-omDilmImYep3aXyoPe1HSHf79Xo7BMu395RUajTWHyeWlilf1llYSUsAk41t468yagW0H9yYWxSxtZ1HukXGLJMIll4lS_2DwWkg%3D%3D)** They are pushing New York City towards higher taxes, diminished job opportunities, unsafe communities, and a stagnating economy.

**As a Member of Congress, I refuse to let that happen.** I won't stand by as they hike your taxes for a personal payday. I won't allow them to release violent, illegal criminals onto our streets. I won't permit them to strip economic growth and job prospects away from our beloved city.

I was hired to find sensible solutions that would fix New York City. I pledge to use my position to protect New Yorkers from taxes and radical policies. **[Your support is crucial as I work to fulfill my promises when New Yorkers voted me in.](http://links.nicolemalliotakis.com/u/click?_t=759a85d1cba743719e64e2569e23c9b8&_m=e2d75e6d32634acaaad18a907544ede6&_e=jQ5NVrl3KlBSU8HwFQZRUOZKSwm8fFI5YVlyO0_6wYZPALcLgXxyoWws00cQ9gr49o3oSdAHYI0qkNf0gVBoZUTMrddIIcGJeKxS-UBauq8f5fDeoyxc4CnO5PrcAwmkM6m2pOr4c3QvwKt8ogBqErRas1pIPyoAQpcCkO6SoWn_00nHMnhaHf2k-YTRz5Lah2Cp_NB4IJLp3Q44Gg3zrYh43le6laf2gMNsLD8zVx4Cq5pRbZri0ZHMbYf26w-DB1WJqtuyYrBZHS_Jnt7UBmEzIOE3n7FdJD7TbXAUQv7j4lglmHEv8dX-Qqzn_53QVPBefTyRUg_NnDDyq5OAZA%3D%3D)**

[ **STAND WITH CONGRESSWOMAN MALLIOTAKIS** ](http://links.nicolemalliotakis.com/u/click?_t=759a85d1cba743719e64e2569e23c9b8&_m=e2d75e6d32634acaaad18a907544ede6&_e=jQ5NVrl3KlBSU8HwFQZRUOZKSwm8fFI5YVlyO0_6wYZPALcLgXxyoWws00cQ9gr49o3oSdAHYI0qkNf0gVBoZUTMrddIIcGJeKxS-UBauq8f5fDeoyxc4CnO5PrcAwmkM6m2pOr4c3QvwKt8ogBqErRas1pIPyoAQpcCkO6SoWn_00nHMnhaHf2k-YTRz5LalgUxTploshaXHdvbu1A1NlSCVVSfJHot9-ICDuDO7D5nTPowxZvPZ2rZVVOQAVhPgWtwKfmCMR5Nk_5uVZHS50qbkOZ4uQwej__ygxo3Y3V0tpLgijoCXHLFfMy4j3b3HJmKEixhLVm1FVXI6IYlgA%3D%3D)

name: PoliticsPA
subject: Shake-up in PA's two-party system
body:
| | | |
---
| | | Welcome to the latest edition of _Voice of Reason_ where we’ll recap exclusive news and data featured in our most recent podcast.

The segment focused on the proposal for open primaries in Pennsylvania, allowing independent voters to participate in the state's primary elections.

David Thornburgh of BallotPA and PA Rep. Jared Solomon joined us to share their views and insights you want to know.
---
| **Big Names Make News**
---
| **Chairman of BallotPA David T****hornburgh** laid out how independent voters will swing key races in PA this election cycle, and said the most compelling way for a candidate to appeal to independents is by supporting their ability to vote in primaries. [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=4bfe27328d&e=b7b3eddce2)]

**PA State Rep. Jared Solomon** explained that in places like Philadelphia where one party dominates, primary elections often determine the final general election outcome. As a result, independent voters may find themselves removed from the process. [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=581d543ee9&e=b7b3eddce2)]
---
|
* * *
---
| **Numbers You Need to Know**
---
| _Elections_
* Over the last 20 years, **80-85% of PA's legislative races have been effectively determined in the primary** – with no opposition or only token opposition in the general election. [[B](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=dc154dd2d6&e=b7b3eddce2)[allotPA](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=f995930521&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Voter Sentiment_
* **75% of primary voters** **surveyed support open primaries** – including 85% of progressive Democrats, and 70% of Republicans. [[BallotPA](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=c55b1777c5&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Policy_
* When PA's closed primary law was passed in 1937, **only 2% of registered voters statewide were Independents** – in some counties that number has grown to close to 20%. [[BallotPA](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=9f2790012b&e=b7b3eddce2)]

---
|
* * *
---
| **House Bill 979 Shakes Up PA's Two-Party Primary System **
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=e3a44d5271&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
|
* * *
---
| **In Case You Missed It**
---
| PoliticsPA was **live on-site at the Harrisburg rotunda** earlier this week recording our signature podcast, _Voices of Reason_.

_Voices of Reason_ podcast has covered the most important issues in Pennsylvania politics – from [education funding](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=6ed83d1aac&e=b7b3eddce2) to [trust in elections](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=5c32853a11&e=b7b3eddce2). Secretary of the Commonwealth [Al Schmidt](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=2fa89a95ac&e=b7b3eddce2), PA Treasurer [Stacy Garrity](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=929bbdd075&e=b7b3eddce2), and House Appropriations Chairman [Jordan Harris](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=92f6f1e729&e=b7b3eddce2) are just a few of many influential guests who have joined us for exclusive interviews and roundtable discussions.

This is exacerbated by shortages of physicians and nurses in the state, which means these facilities are being overrun and struggling to keep up. Despite this, the state legislature continues to ignore the experts in the medical field to address this issue.

clean_body: OK, cousins getting married wasn’t enough for some you...| | | | | = Hi Peter, We recently introduced you to our latest endorsement, Claire Jones for the Tennessee State House, who is running against a man who doesn’t believe contraception should be legal and, when he’s not proudly taking essential healthcare away from women, the “hill he has chosen to die on” is the right for first cousins to marry each other. We’ve heard from many of you that, while Claire’s opponent sounds like a dangerous menace who should not be in any positions of power, you’d like to know more about Claire as a candidate and as a person. = = Claire Jones is a nurse who brings an important perspective to the TN Legislature, especially when there has been such a relentless focus on controlling healthcare and women’s bodies in her state. She understands the importance of reproductive healthcare from both a professional and personal perspective. She believes doctors should have the freedom to provide evidence-based healthcare, and that healthcare decisions should be made between patients and physicians. In short, she believes that lawmakers have no place in the exam room. Additionally, if elected, Claire's priority will be expanding Medicaid. TN is seeing rapid closures of rural hospitals, forcing people to travel far distances to get the care they need. This is exacerbated by shortages of physicians and nurses in the state, which means these facilities are being overrun and struggling to keep up. Despite this, the state legislature continues to ignore the experts in the medical field to address this issue. Claire has stated that education is the foundation of democracy, and is deeply concerned it is under attack. She is also concerned about gun violence and would be a rare voice of reason on this matter among a GOP supermajority in the TN legislature. Only 14% of the TN lawmakers are women. Women's voices are almost completely missing from the rooms where decisions that impact their lives and their bodies are being made – and it shows. It’s critical that we replace this district’s extremist right-wing menace with a voice of experience, compassion, and reason. Here is a look at his record: ❌ He is anti-abortion and has openly told people he doesn't believe contraceptives should be legal because sex should only occur for procreation. ❌ Last legislative session, he sponsored and passed a bill requiring schools to show a fetal development video that has been criticized as being inaccurate by physicians , and made it so parents cannot opt out of having their kids watch the video without opting out of the entire family life curriculum. ❌ He is ANTI-LGBT+, including sponsoring a bill that would ban pride flags from teachers' desks in public schools. Thankfully, the bill failed in the Senate. ❌ He has staunchly defended the right for first cousins to marry in Tennessee. He is also a lawyer and, in his private capacity, is currently suing a school board in the district he represents. When the suit was questioned, he, in his official capacity as a State Representative, proposed legislation that would ensure it had legal standing. name: The Democratic National Committee
subject: Can you take 2 minutes to endorse Joe Biden and Democrats everywhere?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Democratic National Committee, www
body:
It's a small and simple act, but one that will send a very powerful message about the strength and determination of our party.
---
Derek -- The Democratic Party has made a historic investment in organizing this cycle, and as you read this, volunteers and staff are talking to voters across the country, asking them a simple, but important question: **Can we count on your vote for Joe Biden and Democrats up and down the ballot this fall?** Now we want to ask you, Derek, to do the same: [**Add your name to say you support Joe Biden and Democrats up and down the ballot this fall.**](https://ak.democrats.org/signup/endorse-dems/https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-july-elect-dems-2024?refcode=em_20240703_dnc_actives1_rtb_so_so_na-&t=1&akid=240%2E22930333%2EVrM8ax) **[ADD YOUR NAME](https://ak.democrats.org/signup/endorse-dems/https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-july-elect-dems-2024?refcode=em_20240703_dnc_actives1_rtb_so_so_na-&t=2&akid=240%2E22930333%2EVrM8ax)** The 2020 election was incredibly close. Not just the presidential race. Races at all levels were decided by a small number of voters. And our job between now and November is to identify everyone we can who will vote for the Democratic Party this fall, and make sure they have all the resources and information they need to vote. But more than that, it's critical we demonstrate a huge grassroots show of strength and support at this moment, especially before the Republican convention begins. It's a small and simple act, but one that will send a very powerful message about the strength and determination of our party. So what do you say?
