If you are out and about over the next two days, come see me and my campaign and, of course, have fun at the Willits Frontier Days in Mendocino County. We'll be there on the 4th. I’ll also be speaking with voters at the Sonoma County GOP HQ on Saturday, the 6th, from 10 a.m. to 2 p.m. I hope to see you there! I know I’m not the only candidate asking for your support during this turbulent political cycle, so it means a lot when you extend yourself to supply my campaign with the resources we need to unseat a powerful, well-funded incumbent. Our nation, state, and region face enormous problems today. But here’s what we don’t face: the mighty British empire. Compared to the task facing the American revolutionaries 248 years ago, our challenges are imminently conquerable. Yes, our forests are burning, our water sources are under attack, and our communities are grappling with crime, unemployment, and an exodus of working families from a collapsing economy. However, these problems are due to bad leaders and their policies. With our support, good leaders can fix this. Before the fireworks start, I’m hoping you can make a contribution to my campaign in honor of July 4th with a contribution of, , or even . Any amount helps, and if you can’t give today, that’s okay, too. Once again, I wish you, your friends, and your family a very Happy Independence Day! God Bless the U.S.A.! Peter, Last Friday, US Rep. Victoria Spartz (R) was charged with a weapons violation. Hi Peter,
I wanted to wish you a happy Independence Day before we all sign off for the holiday weekend — and tell you what I’m thinking about one day ahead of America’s “birthday.”
Two hundred and forty-eight years ago, the Founders signed the Declaration of Independence and began this great experiment in democracy. For over two centuries, our nation has been guided by the ideal of equality and the pursuit of life, liberty, and happiness.
Our history has been far from perfect, but fighting for a better future is always worth it.
Look, I know it sounds dramatic — but our democracy is at stake this November.
We’re up against a Republican party that will cheat, lie, and steal its way into power.
We saw Donald Trump try to blatantly overturn the 2020 election results, while Republicans like my opponent did nothing but enable him. And now, we have a Supreme Court majority that thinks the President is above the law.
We can’t risk Republicans keeping control of the House of Representatives if Trump wins the presidency.
This year and always, I’m committed to fighting for our freedoms — our freedom to choose what we do with our own bodies, love who we love, vote for who we want, and more. That’s exactly what I’ll do in Congress.
Peter, ahead of this weekend, can I count on you to donate to my campaign and help us flip this seat blue in November? We’re a toss-up race where every dollar counts, and we're running against a Trump-backed MAGA extremist. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_070324_Freedom_act]

Together, we can defend our democratic ideals.

Kirsten

Hey team, Thank you for getting us through our final end-of-quarter fundraising deadline before the primary! When I first ran for public office, it was for a local non-partisan position on the Issaquah City Council. I loved that our focus for the role was about finding solutions that improved the lives of our neighbors, not party politics. Missouri knows what's at stake for reproductive freedom this year.

In Missouri’s 1st congressional district, abortion rights champion and
Justice Democrats incumbent Rep. Cori Bush is fighting to save her seat
from an AIPAC-backed challenger who once managed the campaign of an
anti-abortion conservative.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240703-cb.bR1-sV&refcode=em20240703-35594&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=35594%2E1203867%2EMRLVO- ]Fuel our efforts to get out the vote for Cori before the August 6
primary with a grassroots donation now →

she was raped at the age of 17. Since she was elected to Congress, she’s
fought hard for reproductive freedom and abortion rights for all,
including becoming the first Democratic member of Congress to demand a
repeal of the Comstock Act, an outdated 1873 ‘zombie law’ that Republicans
are trying to use to ban abortion pills and procedures nationwide.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240703-cb.bR1-sV&refcode=em20240703-35594&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=35594%2E1203867%2EMRLVO- ]Tweet from Yuh-Line Niou: Cori Bush testified about her personal

the leader for this moment. St. Louis, on Aug. 6th, your choice is clear.
Vote @CoriBush

But Cori could be unseated by a so-called Democratic challenger who’s
worked for an anti-abortion extremist and is being propped up with
donations from AIPAC’s right-wing megadonors.

Access to abortion, birth control, and IVF continues to be at grave risk,
especially after the Supreme Court recently punted a case around allowing
emergency abortions in states with total bans back to the lower courts.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

_
I was in Montana recently to rally support for Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy as he campaigns to unseat Jon Tester._

When I found out Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy was running for Senate in Montana, I knew I needed to help this decorated warfighter and true patriot defeat the Washington establishment incumbent, Jon Tester.

**Jon Tester has spent his 18-year career in the US Senate working for himself and leaving the people of Montana behind.** He has cozy relationships with powerful lobbyists, special interests, and national Democrat party elites. name: Wes Moore
subject: Here’s what we know
body:
Friend, here’s what we know:

In 126 days, polls across the country will be open and millions of voters will cast their ballots.
The choice is clear: either we elect the candidates that will protect our democracy, or extremists that have made it clear they will stop at nothing to secure their power to chip away at our rights and our freedoms.

As someone who has spent years of their life fighting for freedom, I am not willing to support extremists. This election will be one of the most important elections in our lifetime — and we have to act now to support Democrats up and down the ticket. We have a Senate seat, House races, and the Legislature all up for election, and every race matters. The Senate majority is on the line — November’s election will determine who has the 51st seat and whether we can keep our majority.

Today, I am asking you to make a split contribution between my campaign and the Maryland Democratic Party, because who wins in November will determine if we keep our majority in the Senate. We need to raise the resources to ensure we reach every voter to support Democrats. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20240703-1?refcode=em20240703-1]

Make a split contribution » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20240703-1?refcode=em20240703-1]

We cannot underestimate just how much is at stake this year. Democracy, reproductive access, health care, housing, and so much more are on the line. We must support Democrats this year so we can keep our majority.

Elevate,

Wes

Hey, Harry Dunn here.

This is a tough email to start – how do you talk about one of the darkest days of your life? Not to mention, an irreparable stain on this country's history. So I guess I'll start with a question. Is this America?

Is attacking Capitol police officers – honest, good people dedicated to protecting and serving democracy – with baseball bats and spears, spraying them with WD-40, calling them nasty slurs – is that America?

Is a President of the United States emboldening a riot on the Capitol, encouraging people who threaten to kill Speaker Emerita Nancy Pelosi, former Vice President Mike Pence – is that America?

A Supreme Court that allows violent insurrectionists and a President who directed their riot to get away without repercussions, is that America?

**That's not American to me.** I believe in an America that protects its people, regardless of their political beliefs. An America that values democracy and those that are chosen to represent it. That's what I believed in while I served as a Capitol police officer during the January 6 insurrection.

**This weekend we're going to celebrate freedom. I'll be celebrating the version of America I believe in. Where abortion rights, voting rights, and other personal freedoms are protected. Where billionaires don't decide elections. Where the leader of the country isn't actively threatening our democracy.**

Pramila is showing up for working people and holding big corporations accountable for their greed.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20240703-4067-footer&t=1&akid=4067%2E420207%2ELdnlVI)
Peter, big corporations are trying to use taxpayer dollars to subsidize massive windfalls for their wealthy executives and shareholders — _but Pramila and Elizabeth Warren are leading the fight to stop this corporate greed._
**It’s true:** $8.5 billion from the CHIPS Act is going to a corporation that has plans to make a $7.24 billion “stock buyback” – a tool that corporations use to provide massive payouts for CEOs and Wall Street.
That’s not right. Our taxpayer dollars shouldn’t help line the pockets of the rich and powerful. It should go toward constructing a fair, strong economy.
**_Thankfully, Pramila and Elizabeth Warren are fighting back._** They just released a _scathing_ letter that calls out this corporate greed for what it is and demands the U.S. Commerce Department live up to the promises made to Pramila when the CHIPS Act was first passed by Congress: Corporations can’t use CHIPS funding to subsidize stock buybacks.
Pramila is showing up for working people and holding big corporations accountable for their greed. This is what it means to fight for an economy that works for EVERYONE — not just those at the top.

body:
The third rail in American politics.
#
This is the cycle where we are seeing a confrontation with AIPAC – the American Israel Public Affairs Committee — happen head on for the first time.
For so long the fear of standing up for Palestinian human rights and _actually_ fighting for a lasting peace has been the third rail in American politics.
This is the cycle where we’ve decided, between the absolute indiscriminate attacks and an unfolding genocide in Gaza, that we are standing up and saying: **Enough.**
From Day 1 we have called for a ceasefire in the region. Since Day 1, we have advocated for the human rights of Palestinians. **And from Day 1, they have put a target on our back.**
**There isn't just one election this November – there are _hundreds_.** The left must win as many of them as possible to halt the immediate threat of fascism _and_ expand our strength in Congress to chart a path of policy transformation. **We can, and must, do both**. [Will you split a $2 contribution today between AOC's campaign and leadership PAC, Courage to Change — $1 for each team? Your support will have an immediate impact on progressive campaigns, their ability to organize, and their shot at victory over AIPAC.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240703.dgualj&refcode=em20240703-6753-P_FND_EGR_CTC&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6753%2E2526796%2EicEq8F)
---
I want to be very clear that AIPAC is not representative or in alignment with the views of the vast majority of Americans, of Democrats, and especially generationally, many in the Jewish community.
They seek to artificially conflate some of the most conservative and war-hawk stances with bad faith accusations that criticism of the Netanyahu Administration or how Gazans are treated is somehow anti-semitic.
**We must stand up undeterred**.
They’re raising significant resources from, and are financed by, Republicans. They endorse Republicans who supported the January 6th attacks.**
It’s so important to understand that the threat to democracy — both that Netanyahu represents in Israel and that Trump represents in the United States — are being supported by many of the individuals that support AIPAC as well.
**This is a question of democracy. This is a question of making sure that we are not torn up by the racist attacks that AIPAC engages in.**
[Will you make a $2 contribution right now between our campaign and Courage to Change to power our fight to win back the House this November?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240703.dgualj&refcode=em20240703-6753-P_FND_EGR_CTC&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=6753%2E2526796%2EicEq8F) **[Contribute $2](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240703.dgualj&refcode=em20240703-6753-P_FND_EGR_CTC&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=6753%2E2526796%2EicEq8F)**
---
For the first time in modern American politics, conditioning aid to Israel is becoming a mainstream conversation in D.C. That has never happened before.
**And it’s happening because of the support, activism, and organizing of people like you.**
Thank you,
Alexandria

Peter, last month, we took a huge step forward to protect our New York children and teens.
New York enacted two new laws to protect children from the harmful effects of social media: the Stop Addictive Feeds Exploitation (SAFE) For Kids Act and the New York Child Data Protection Act.

I’ve been working with my partners in the New York legislature on these laws for over a year.
**These two laws will keep powerful Big Tech giants in check, protecting children from their addictive algorithms and putting a stop to the monetization and commoditization of their personal data.**

name: Jocelyn Benson
subject: It’s up to us
body:
Friends,

As many of us head out to celebrate the Fourth of July, our nation's Independence Day, with friends and neighbors - we are at the same time in the midst of one of the most turbulent times our democracy has faced since its birth nearly 248 years ago.

This week, the United States Supreme Court dealt what could be a serious blow to our democracy with its ruling on the Donald Trump immunity case. By granting the former President immunity for "official acts," they have opened the door to endlessly defining and redefining what constitutes official acts. Was inciting a coup an official act? Was pressuring the Georgia Secretary of State to "find him some votes" an official act? And so on.

It's clear that the accountability necessary to preserve our democracy will not be coming from any Supreme Court ruling or court case.

You've heard me say that democracy is a decision. So is accountability - and the pathway to accountability has always been, and continues to be, the ballot box.

What does accountability look like? We don't need to look further than what's happening right here in Michigan. Just this past week in Michigan, the Senate passed a significant transparency bill that has been in the works for almost a decade. It passed because voters took to the polls and elected representatives who were committed to getting it done.

In the face of all the challenges our democracy is facing on a national level, I wanted to call out this achievement here in Michigan. Not because it is a silver bullet or solves the structural problems we are facing at a national level -- but because it shows what can happen when citizens make the decision to vote for pro-democracy, pro-transparency, pro-accountability candidates.

That's our blueprint for defending our democracy in Michigan, both this fall and in the years to come. I'm committed to continuing our historic legacy of secure and transparent elections in Michigan. It's why I launched the Michigan Legacy PAC - and why we all have a role to play as democracy defenders this fall.

As election season kicks into high gear later this summer, our network of Democracy Defenders across the state will help pro-democracy candidates at every level win. If you haven't yet - sign up to join our growing movement and we'll be in touch with specific ways you can help and which races need our time and effort the most. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/XKcSYNkVzEe7gEpPDR9zew2]

The past few days may seem disheartening. But for me, it's a reminder that our democracy is in our hands -- and will only slip away if we let it.

So let's double down and all make the decision, together, to defend it.

Onward,
Jocelyn

_
I was in Montana recently to rally support for Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy as he campaigns to unseat Jon Tester._

When I found out Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy was running for Senate in Montana, I knew I needed to help this decorated warfighter and true patriot defeat the Washington establishment incumbent, Jon Tester.

**Jon Tester has spent his 18-year career in the US Senate working for himself and leaving the people of Montana behind.** He has cozy relationships with powerful lobbyists, special interests, and national Democrat party elites. #### U.S. Representative Jason Crow (CO-06): Refuses to take stance on Joe Biden's Fitness for Office
|
---
**Denver, CO** \- Jason Crow, among other Colorado leading Democrats, has refused to give public comments on whether President Joe Biden is still fit to serve as President of the United States. As the nation engages in critical discussions surrounding the mental fitness of President Joe Biden, the voters of Colorado's 6th Congressional District seek clarity from their representative, Jason Crow. As a key member of the Colorado Democratic Party and respected member of the House of Representatives, his silence is surprising. Following the first Presidential debate on June 27, Crow and other leading Democrats declined an interview with local news outlet, 9News. However, like most of his colleagues, Crow did give a limited statement claiming, "The President had a tough night, but we don't make decisions off one debate" ([here](https://wrzeyj.clicks.mlsend.com/tl/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjgzNDExMCxcImxcIjoxMjU4NjYwMTQ4ODM3MTAyNDEsXCJyXCI6MTI1ODY2MDE5MTQ4MjY5MDgxfSIsInMiOiIyOTM4YzUxODRkOTMxZmYxIn0)). Silence on such a pressing issue, after a debate that could be considered nothing short of "disastrous" for President Biden and the Democratic Party, has created uncertainty and speculation across the nation. John Fabbricatore stated: "I was shocked by the incoherent rambling mess I witness last Thursday, and as an Air Force veteran who secured our nation's nuclear warheads the idea of Joe Biden's finger being on the button is absolutely terrifying. I will be clear: Joe Biden is unfit for office period." ###

This is significant: Nonpartisan political forecasters at Sabato’s Crystal Ball have officially downgraded the race for the presidency here in Michigan from “Lean D” to “Toss-Up.” Sabato’s Crystal Ball has a record of accurate predictions, making it a top major ratings organization in American politics.
This downgrade comes just a few days after a new poll showing our race for U.S Senate in a dead heat -- with a LOT of voters still undecided.
Add it all up, and it becomes clear Michigan is a must-win state to keep the White House, keep the Senate, and flip the House.
And then there’s this: because the presidential is now a toss-up race, it makes it exceedingly more likely that our race will be a toss-up, too.
And in practical terms, news like this sends a signal to dark money spending groups that Michigan is seriously competitive -- meaning they will undoubtedly pour millions into our race attacking Elissa and propping up our eventual opponent.
This is why we reach out to you with the frequency that we do: we’re focused on ensuring our campaign has the resources necessary to fight back against the attack ads and outside spending that are quickly coming our way.

# **Cheyney University Accreditation is Reaffirmed**
**** We're proud to share that [Cheyney University's accreditation has been reaffirmed](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168193.172202.17&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11194), meaning the historically Black state school is no longer on probation. Back in February, Senator Hughes joined Cheyney President Aaron Walton and other leaders to call out the disappointing and unfair Middle States probationary status the University was put on. [At the time, President Walton explained](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168193.172202.17&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11196), "This action diverges significantly from the standard protocol, where a warning phase proceeds probation, raising concerns about the fairness and transparency of the decision making process. It calls into question procedural fairness and transparency in the accreditation process and also sets a concerning precedent for the accreditation process of HBCUs." After working directly with Middle States and standing their ground against the probationary status, Middle States announced this week that Cheyney will keep their accreditation. [Senator Hughes expressed his strong support of the decision](http://enews.senatorhughes.com/mail/util.cfm?mailaction=clickthru&gpiv=2100168193.172202.17&gen=1&mailing_linkid=11197) and the need to focus on moving forward instead of dwelling on the disservice the back and forth of Cheyney's status did for current and future students: **" We want to get things moving at Cheyney in a much more aggressive fashion now that this cloud has been lifted off of us. Cheyney University provides a very special, nurturing HBCU experience that is consistent with its history." - Senator Hughes** **** Cheyney University is the oldest HBCU in the country and has provided a quality education to a number of young leaders. Alumni include civil rights activists Octavius Catto and Bayard Rustin, the journalist Ed Bradley, and the newspaper publisher Robert W. Bogle. It's important to remember and honor the legacy of this institution and look to the many ways leaders can continue making Cheyney one of the best HBCUs in the country. **"In a world where people are getting less and less sensitive to Black and brown students, we need to make sure that universities with the traditional and historic mission of our HBCUs are invested in and that families know that they're very viable options for their children. " - Senator Hughes**

| | Dear Friend, Understanding our rights and freedoms is absolutely vital. As Americans, we are called to be informed and active participants in our communities, and this has never been more essential than it is today. From working as a Congressional Chief of Staff, I know the power and importance of active citizenship. That's why I'm excited to share that on **Independence Day, July 4th** , Belmont Abbey College is launching a new online course titled "Rights and Freedoms." In today's increasingly polarizing environment, understanding our rights and freedoms is essential for fostering informed citizenship, promoting social harmony, and safeguarding individual liberties. Our course is designed to guide you through these complex issues, offering a thorough exploration that combines historical context, philosophical insights, and practical implications. Here's a sneak peek of the lessons you will explore:
* **Bill of Rights with Hadley Arkes, Founder and Co-Director of the James Wilson Institute on Natural Rights and the American Founding and the Edward Ney Professor of Jurisprudence at Amherst College:** Discover this crucial document's historical significance and its relationship to our foundational principles.
* **Freedom of Speech with Chris Bedford, Vice Chairman of Young Americans for Freedom, Board Member at the National Journalism Center, Senior Editor for Politics, and Washington correspondent for Blaze Media:** Understand the protections of this fundamental right and the threats to it.
* **Freedom of Religion with Nina Shea,Senior Fellow and Director of the Center for Religious Freedom at Hudson Institute and former Commissioner of the United States Commission on International Religious Freedom:** Dive into the importance of religious freedom and its role in our society.
* **True Freedom with Belmont Abbey monk Br. Chrysostom Sica, OSB:** Explore freedom's deeper meaning from a philosophical and theological perspective.
* **Implications of True Freedom with Dr. Tom Varacalli, Assistant Professor of Great Books in the Honors College at Belmont Abbey College:** Build on these perspectives and address their practical implications.
* **Congress ' role with Robert Smith, resident of the Thomas More Society of America and Deputy Chief Counsel, Oversight of the Senate Commerce, Science and Transportation Committee:** Learn about the pivotal role of government committees in preserving our rights.

**Why should you consider enrolling?** Whether you're a student, lifelong learner, legal professional, or community leader, this course offers invaluable insights to support your personal and professional growth and to defend the great American experiment in freedom. It will better prepare you to do your part to, in the words of Abraham Lincoln, "nobly save . . . the last best hope of Earth." This Independence Day, make a commitment to your country to be informed on your rights and freedoms before November. You can register for "Rights and Freedoms" at this url [www.bac.edu/rights](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=e7150ab668dc40448e05c4552abe443f&_e=nlhGk2s3KfCJ9j4sH1zsSkAU_iNs7c8YSVjgFx2kV8sAuqIA5pJhRaTR-UhgnXEuMcd82DxQ2c8WihSrzlt1sHlHizCAivDSdH4Zg5OIrg_r5U99_H9uZgPF0HUIu-8Xrt5kIok5OjW01q_CNO-BMD_15i4HdFqq74QX0sj92YZGNOE7e9UMZ6eqjw5f5m77afGE1coN5IrDuVwKMvAkQlTPnXBLk4WwWuZE4p3hsC6y16SHxEQmM3IHJ1h-hZepuLzAanS1-tP2BAWIqkoAvGGPiVVTerSmSTqgRJ2_UnqBpjeqlSnNEQiNA_3cIUo_HXE19WESbvOJXdF6RAJ4cmbon4KwI1ls5rzl9twaNC0%3D) That in all things God may be glorified,

In today's increasingly polarizing environment, understanding our rights and freedoms is essential for fostering informed citizenship, promoting social harmony, and safeguarding individual liberties. Our course is designed to guide you through these complex issues, offering a thorough exploration that combines historical context, philosophical insights, and practical implications. Here's a sneak peek of the lessons you will explore: Bill of Rights with Hadley Arkes, Founder and Co-Director of the James Wilson Institute on Natural Rights and the American Founding and the Edward Ney Professor of Jurisprudence at Amherst College: Discover this crucial document's historical significance and its relationship to our foundational principles. Freedom of Speech with Chris Bedford, Vice Chairman of Young Americans for Freedom, Board Member at the National Journalism Center, Senior Editor for Politics, and Washington correspondent for Blaze Media: Understand the protections of this fundamental right and the threats to it. Freedom of Religion with Nina Shea,Senior Fellow and Director of the Center for Religious Freedom at Hudson Institute and former Commissioner of the United States Commission on International Religious Freedom: Dive into the importance of religious freedom and its role in our society. True Freedom with Belmont Abbey monk Br. Chrysostom Sica, OSB: Explore freedom's deeper meaning from a philosophical and theological perspective. Implications of True Freedom with Dr. Tom Varacalli, Assistant Professor of Great Books in the Honors College at Belmont Abbey College: Build on these perspectives and address their practical implications. Congress ' role with Robert Smith, resident of the Thomas More Society of America and Deputy Chief Counsel, Oversight of the Senate Commerce, Science and Transportation Committee: Learn about the pivotal role of government committees in preserving our rights. Why should you consider enrolling? Whether you're a student, lifelong learner, legal professional, or community leader, this course offers invaluable insights to support your personal and professional growth and to defend the great American experiment in freedom. It will better prepare you to do your part to, in the words of Abraham Lincoln, "nobly save . . . the last best hope of Earth." This Independence Day, make a commitment to your country to be informed on your rights and freedoms before November. You can register for "Rights and Freedoms" at this url That in all things God may be glorified, Philip L. Brach Jr. Vice President of College Relations Belmont Abbey College .

name: Sarah McBride
subject: More updates from the trail!
body:
Getting to hear from my neighbors throughout the state is my favorite part of campaigning, so here are the highlights of the last few weeks.
#
Just a few weeks ago I emailed you with a ton of pictures of all the places I’d been to recently on the campaign trail. Well let me tell you, I’ve been doing so much travel up and down Delaware that now I have a whole lot more to share!
**Getting to hear from my neighbors throughout the state is my favorite part of campaigning, so here are the highlights of the last few weeks.**
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240703-1?refcode=em20240703-1&amount=5&refcode2=751_21716_bjLvHv&akid=751%2E21716%2EbjLvHv)
Most recently I had the chance to attend the third annual Unity Day BBQ in Dover. It was hosted by the one-and-only Dover Councilman Andre Boggerty, and it was an absolute blast! So great to see so many old and new friends.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240703-1?refcode=em20240703-1&amount=5&refcode2=751_21716_bjLvHv&akid=751%2E21716%2EbjLvHv)
I’m also so grateful to the Wilmington and New Castle County Democrats for inviting me to help open their 2024 rally and workshop. I’m so excited that Democrats are united as we work to hold the White House, elect Lisa Blunt Rochester to the Senate, win our campaign for the House, and send Delaware Democrats to Dover in record numbers! 🏆
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240703-1?refcode=em20240703-1&amount=5&refcode2=751_21716_bjLvHv&akid=751%2E21716%2EbjLvHv)
I also had the privilege to kick off a beautiful Saturday morning surrounded by friends and community and faith leaders at the annual MLK Prayer Breakfast. The energy in that room was so uplifting!
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240703-1?refcode=em20240703-1&amount=5&refcode2=751_21716_bjLvHv&akid=751%2E21716%2EbjLvHv)
And I certainly can’t forget speaking at The Democracy Summer Project, a fantastic seminar about my job as a state senator, the health of our democracy, and the major issues facing our state. A huge thanks to Ed Freel for organizing this program and helping facilitate connections between government and Delaware educators!
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240703-1?refcode=em20240703-1&amount=5&refcode2=751_21716_bjLvHv&akid=751%2E21716%2EbjLvHv)
One extra special event for me was the 50th anniversary of the Italian Festival. It was so fun to march in the annual St. Anthony’s Procession of the Saints! (Big thanks to Grand Marshall Italo Carrieri-Russo for letting me march alongside him.)
I remember attending the Italian Festival every year as a kid and it was always a highlight of my summer. So great to be back this year! 🇮🇹
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240703-1?refcode=em20240703-1&amount=5&refcode2=751_21716_bjLvHv&akid=751%2E21716%2EbjLvHv)
And last but certainly not least, I was so happy to see Wilmington turn out for the annual Juneteenth festival in Tubman-Garrett Park.
Delaware has been celebrating Juneteenth long before it became a national holiday, and it was great to see so many people — including my nieces Sydney and Teagan — out for music, food, community resources, and to commemorate a day that honors the fight for racial justice.
We’ve certainly been busy, and we’re not slowing down any time soon. This campaign is only just beginning! And I’m so grateful to have folks like you by my side.
[**If you’re ready to help us win this race in November, will you pitch in $5 today? We’ve got a long campaign ahead, and your support makes a world of difference.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240703-1?refcode=em20240703-1&amount=5&refcode2=751_21716_bjLvHv&akid=751%2E21716%2EbjLvHv)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240703-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240703-1-751&refcode2=751_21716_bjLvHv&akid=751%2E21716%2EbjLvHv)**
Thank you,
Sarah McBride
* * *
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-footer?refcode=em20240703-1&t=1&refcode2=751_21716_bjLvHv&akid=751%2E21716%2EbjLvHv)**

Will voting for do-nothing Dems fix the Supreme Court?

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/nv?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=scotus&n=1)
---
Peter, Every four years, we're regularly told to "vote blue no matter who" because of the Supreme Court. But voting for Democrats to fix the Supreme Court is betting on a sure loser. It's not happening. **Democrats aren't saving SCOTUS - and they're not saving _us_ from SCOTUS either.** While Republicans have been carefully strategizing a judicial takeover for decades, Democrats have been fumbling away SCOTUS seats and fast-tracking GOP judicial appointees. **When it leaked that SCOTUS was planning to overturn Roe, the Democrats did nothing** to codify this critical protection for women, just like they'd done nothing for the past 50 years in spite of their repeated promises. **All they did was fundraise and tell people to vote blue harder.** When SCOTUS gutted the Voting Rights Act, the Democrats did nothing but fundraise and tell people to vote harder. **Now that SCOTUS has gone full mask-off in support of tyranny, what are Biden and the Democrats doing about it?_Fundraising and telling people to vote harder._** The Democrats have not only been useless while SCOTUS takes a sledgehammer to our democracy. They have been worse than useless, because they turn every terrible decision into a convenient excuse for not even trying to do the things they promised their voters. **Enough is enough.** We're done playing along with this farce. Voting for Biden to deal with this illegitimate, corrupt, rogue court is like calling Mr. Magoo to stop a fascist coup. We need to call it like it is: this court has sided with tyranny over democracy, and just like King George III in 1776, it's got to go. But we won't win this fight by voting for the do-nothing Dems. **We will win this fight by voting for a president who will lead the charge to impeach, replace, and expand this illegitimate, corrupt court** \- and create a court that serves the American people, not the billionaire donors that have manipulated the process to produce an extremist court now tearing down what remains of our democratic institutions. **If you want to vote for a president who will actually do what it takes to fight the rogue Supreme Court, please pitch in whatever you can now to help us make sure _every_ voter has that choice in November.**

Jill Stein

It’s our chance to take back the Senate from the Democrats. Sherrod Brown, Bernie’s opponent, is spending over $100 million and counting to keep his seat and continue pushing his destructive policies. The spending in this race is astronomical and historic, and it shows just how desperate the Democrats are to hold onto power. But we have something they don’t: faith, determination, and an unyielding belief in the American Dream. This fight won’t be easy, and we will need to match the Democrats' efforts if we want to take back Ohio and the Senate. This is a battle for the soul of our nation, and I hope you’ll join us. God bless, Senator Tim Scott Meet Bernie Moreno: | Bernie Moreno fights for the American Dream because he’s lived it. Bernie was born in Bogota, Colombia. At age five, his American Dream began when he moved to the United States with his family. Bernie became an American citizen at age 18. Through his relentless work ethic and untamable entrepreneurial spirit, he turned the first car dealership that he purchased in 2005 into one of the largest dealership groups in America. In 2016, Bernie recognized the value and transformational potential of blockchain technology, before it received mainstream attention, and moved much of his volunteer time and investment dollars into the space. In 2018 he co-founded ChampTitles, which grew to be quite successful as Bernie served as Chairman of the Board. After a long, successful career, Bernie sold most of his business to begin focusing on his calling: protecting the American dream for another generation. Solving our country’s problems requires common sense. In Washington, Bernie will fight to shrink government, protect our freedoms, stop the Chinese Communist party from taking our data and land, and always put America First. Ohioans are done with politicians who talk a big game and do nothing. Bernie wants to go to D.C. to get work done – just like he always has. | Peter,

In a hard-fought race like ours, we know every single bit of support can make a critical difference this November.

With Nancy Mace running to undermine our democracy and secure her place in the MAGA Hall of Fame, the stakes couldn’t be higher for our district and country — that much is clear.

The good news is Team Moore is coming out on top — because we’ve got the momentum, organizing power, and support to make it happen. I’m proud to share that our team met our end-of-quarter FEC fundraising goal on Sunday, a major stepping stone in our fight to take back SC-01 from MAGA extremism.

Thank you for standing with me, the Lowcountry, and the people who make this place so special. Together — and only together — we can win this thing and build a Congress that truly serves each and every one of us.

Friend, let me paint a picture for you. The year is 1787. It’s September in Philadelphia. Delegates were leaving the Constitutional Convention after long hours of writing our Constitution. As they were leaving, Benjamin Franklin was asked what kind of government we had. He answered back: **_“A Republic, if you can keep it.”_** We look back in awe of what our Founding Fathers achieved, building a nation based upon the rule of law. They knew it would be impossible to have a perfect union, but even “with all of its faults,” it gave us a foundation. The foundation being “We, the people.” [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88198777/483440939/1889740758?refcode=AU_JC_FR_GEN_GEN_AC30_20240703_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNTE4M2MzMy04NjM5LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qxCYSxvF7WPi5UXcjtsZN8gMhpgVRrqchZl69XgiK3w=) I look back at that experience to ground my work in Congress. It shows that America is at its best when we put self-interest aside. As a former Army Ranger, I know that to be true. I served alongside brave men and women who weren’t afraid to put their lives on the line for our country’s values. To defend our system of checks and balances. To prevent tyranny and make sure that nobody is above the law. To defend America. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88198778/483440940/1889740758?refcode=AU_JC_FR_GEN_GEN_AC30_20240703_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODUyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNTE4M2MzMy04NjM5LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qxCYSxvF7WPi5UXcjtsZN8gMhpgVRrqchZl69XgiK3w=) **It’s been almost 250 years since the Constitution was drafted — and to be frank, many folks feel that our democratic system is more fragile than ever.** We have demagogues who are more determined to limit our freedoms than expand them. We have leaders more focused on attaining power than giving it back to the people. But we cannot be discouraged. We must continue our fight to defend our country. Democracy isn’t a spectator sport. It is built upon decades and centuries of progress — folks like you and me standing strong to protect our democracy. The work isn’t easy, but it’s the only way we can keep our country and the values we hold dear. **[We are now less than 150 days until the November election. This article will not make you feel good, and it does not have a happy conclusion promising everything will be all right. Because with Project 2025, we are beyond mere arrival of fascism in America--we are on the cusp of full blown fascism. As I wrote recently, the [grotesque Supreme Court decisions this session](https://substack.com/redirect/3755b031-11ba-43f6-8a56-46258338baa8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--including expanding Presidential immunity to include hypothetically assassinating a political opponent as an 'official' act--demonstrate how dire a situation we are in. Indeed, such decisions are ultimately the result of Project 2025. Electing Trump will further accelerate Project 2025's goal of implementing Christian nationalism in American government.
So, what is Project 2025 and why should we care? **Let 's Address This.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/8700b90b-b9da-43ca-ba99-c3eadcef16a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

## **What Is Project 2025 and Why Should We Care?**
Project 2025 is a well funded MAGA theocratic fantasy turned reality. Established only in 2022, it already has a $22 million budget, which it is using to achieve its goal of exerting Christian nationalist control over the Federal government's Executive, Legislative, and Judicial branches.
The founder of Project 2025 is a self identified Christian nationalist named Kevin Roberts. Roberts also leads The Heritage Foundation, a right wing think tank that has successfully implemented numerous extremist conservative policies--including helping overturn Roe. Roberts describes Project 2025 as a ruthless takeover of our secular government, one that promises bloodshed to anyone who doesn't comply. In an interview on the known pro-white supremacist Steve Bannon's podcast, Roberts [boasted](https://substack.com/redirect/70870972-f7f6-4e52-89fb-46453dba40da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> In spite of all this nonsense from the left, we are going to win. We're in the process of taking this country back. We are in the process of the second American Revolution, which will remain bloodless, if the left allows it to be.
On the Executive level, Project 2025 is working to elect Donald Trump to complete their government takeover. With Trump at the helm, they will seek to abolish the Department of Education and reallocate federal tax dollars to school choice, enforce a national ban on mifepristone, severely limit immigration and exploit those seeking asylum through monetizing their suffering, gut climate justice initiatives, and increase fossil fuel usage despite the climate crisis. Project 2025 also seeks to purge anyone not openly right wing conservative from the Federal government, including from non-partisan civil service roles.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e70e8a41-66ab-4320-ba5e-2e11d525a04b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Credit: The Guardian
On the Legislative side, Project 2025 is well on its way with MAGA GOP Speaker Mike Johnson. Johnson is already a self-described Christian nationalist and has openly advocated for Biblical rule. For example, when asked how he would make public policy, Johnson [replied](https://substack.com/redirect/b5536e97-c6fb-4170-b6d4-ffc3587fc816?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Well, go pick up a Bible off your shelf and read it. That's my worldview.
And it gets worse. As The Guardian [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/b5536e97-c6fb-4170-b6d4-ffc3587fc816?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Johnson's inerrant biblical truth leads him to reject science. Johnson was a "young earth creationist", holding that a literal reading of Genesis means that the earth is only a few thousand years old and humans walked alongside [dinosaurs](https://substack.com/redirect/26a1fb77-f7d0-4583-959e-eaae83f1139e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). He has been the attorney for and partner in Kentucky's Creation Museum and Ark amusement park, which present these beliefs as scientific fact, a familiar sleight of hand where the end (garnering more believers) justifies the means (lying about science). For them, the end always justifies the means. That's why they don't even blink when non-believers suffer for their dogma.
And as you might guess, Project 2025 is already miles ahead on the Judicial branch of government. Indeed, their corrupt worldview is made possible by their knowledge that their right wing Supreme Court will rubber stamp their Christian nationalist authoritarianism. This is all made possible by right wing billionaires [spending hundreds of millions of dollars](https://substack.com/redirect/6af4b940-e103-4547-b401-1f651c74445e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to hand select and install right wing Supreme Court justices--as they did with Kavanaugh, Gorsuch, and Barrett. As a result, the current Supreme Court is further right than the vast majority of Americans, and perpetuates an [unjust trend of conservative control of the Supreme Court](https://substack.com/redirect/fd04630a-5e19-44a8-9357-d0b2c533d35f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) despite liberal popular vote victories at the Presidential level.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/57ea11ac-ea11-4f72-8895-5aad708021b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Median Judicial Ideology of Supreme Court Justices since 1937. Source: Martin-Quinn Scores
In short, Project 2025 seeks to fully transform the United States into a banana republic and theocracy--both concepts repugnant to a U.S. Constitution committed to secular governance and equal access under the law. And given the success these right wing extremists have had in taking over the United States Supreme Court and hundreds of members of the United States Congress, it would be unwise to dismiss them as unserious in their attempts to win back the White House.
There's no easy answer and no flip of a switch that will stop this violent assault on our democracy. But that is why it is that much more critical we stay engaged in the political process, stay educated and informed ourselves, hold our elected representatives accountable, and not be bystanders. I'm hopeful this heavy piece has provided at least some more clarity for you, and you can be assured I will continue to raise awareness on this existential threat to our country and Constitution.
Our Republic has so far survived 248 years. If we do not maintain secular governance this November, we may not make it to 250.

For example, when asked how he would make public policy, Johnson : Well, go pick up a Bible off your shelf and read it. That's my worldview. And it gets worse. As The Guardian : Johnson's inerrant biblical truth leads him to reject science. Johnson was a "young earth creationist", holding that a literal reading of Genesis means that the earth is only a few thousand years old and humans walked alongside . He has been the attorney for and partner in Kentucky's Creation Museum and Ark amusement park, which present these beliefs as scientific fact, a familiar sleight of hand where the end (garnering more believers) justifies the means (lying about science). For them, the end always justifies the means. That's why they don't even blink when non-believers suffer for their dogma. And as you might guess, Project 2025 is already miles ahead on the Judicial branch of government. Indeed, their corrupt worldview is made possible by their knowledge that their right wing Supreme Court will rubber stamp their Christian nationalist authoritarianism. This is all made possible by right wing billionaires to hand select and install right wing Supreme Court justices--as they did with Kavanaugh, Gorsuch, and Barrett. As a result, the current Supreme Court is further right than the vast majority of Americans, and perpetuates an despite liberal popular vote victories at the Presidential level. | | ---|---|--- Median Judicial Ideology of Supreme Court Justices since 1937. Source: Martin-Quinn Scores In short, Project 2025 seeks to fully transform the United States into a banana republic and theocracy--both concepts repugnant to a U.S. Constitution committed to secular governance and equal access under the law. And given the success these right wing extremists have had in taking over the United States Supreme Court and hundreds of members of the United States Congress, it would be unwise to dismiss them as unserious in their attempts to win back the White House. There's no easy answer and no flip of a switch that will stop this violent assault on our democracy. But that is why it is that much more critical we stay engaged in the political process, stay educated and informed ourselves, hold our elected representatives accountable, and not be bystanders. I'm hopeful this heavy piece has provided at least some more clarity for you, and you can be assured I will continue to raise awareness on this existential threat to our country and Constitution. Our Republic has so far survived 248 years. If we do not maintain secular governance this November, we may not make it to 250. Let's Address This with Qasim Rashid is a reader-supported publication. In stark contrast, Robert F. Kennedy Jr. stood out with his lucid, insightful, and statesmanlike demeanor during "The Real Debate." His approach was not only presidential but also visionary, demonstrating a clear, original perspective on the pressing issues that matter most to Americans.

name: Madeleine Dean
subject: Join us at the Glenside 4th Parade!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mad4PA PAC
body:
**** Hi Peter — I wanted to reach out to thank you for helping with our end-of-quarter fundraising goal. I’m feeling positive about our momentum going into these summer months.

Now that the 4th of July is here, my team and I are excited to march in both the Glenside and Skippack 4th of July parades tomorrow. If you’ve been with me for a while you’ll know that the Glenside parade, in particular, is the same one I loved attending every year growing up. It’s one of the nation’s oldest consecutive parades – the first being in 1904!
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/88199901/483444739/-398328110?refcode=07032024_MD_EN_EOQTY_1&refcode2=bced2566-8a39-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiY2VkMjU2Ni04YTM5LWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pxsnjKp6Vt9Re0uUMyXTZWaJ4Um2TFESNuG58LZkF_8=&emci=6c924267-9b38-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=bced2566-8a39-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=36373569)
_Mad and the team enjoying meeting folks at the Glenside Parade!_
I’m honored to march in this parade and represent the communities I’ve called home my whole life — and getting to do it alongside the hard-working folks of PA-04 makes it even more special. **If you’re in the area, come out and say hi to me and my team!**

My favorite part of the parade has to be handing out the candy to the children along the route. Two years ago, we brought 100 pounds of candy, last year, we brought 120 pounds. body:
# [#] Team,

I just got off the phone with our Finance Team: thanks to people like you, we met our end of quarter goal! I’m so grateful to each and every one of our supporters who have stood with our campaign. We know that we’ve got a long road ahead to keep this seat blue in November, but I know I can count on our grassroots base to help us win this thing.

As you may have heard in the news, it’s been a busy time on Capitol Hill. I’m working to build bipartisan support to advance commonsense policies like I’ve always done. However, many of my extreme far-right colleagues don’t much feel like working together these days. The NRCC is doing everything in its power to expand its slim majority – which means they are going to flood money right into this district in an attempt to elect “MAGA Mary” Guinchard.

We need to keep up our momentum from now until Election Day. Can you chip in anything you can to help our grassroots efforts? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jg-fr-2407?amount=]

We count on you to help us keep pace with everything the far-right can throw at us: thank you for standing by my side in this fight.

Yours,
Josh

| | Dear Fellow American, American civics education, and specifically the teaching of American history, is at a crisis point. In K-12 schools nationwide, false narratives are being constructed, and content is being cherry-picked to fit an ideological (and frankly anti-American) agenda. Maybe you've even seen this happening in your local schools. As a result, we are faced with a choice: will we allow our children to be indoctrinated using curricula developed by anti-American ideologues and promoted by Left-wing education bureaucrats? Or will we insist that our children are taught honestly, using a curriculum that presents a fair, unbiased, and comprehensive view of our nation's history? We must insist on the **latter** , both for the sake of truth and for the sake of our children and America's future. For this reason, we have produced the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ --and I'm writing to ask your help in promoting this curriculum to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide. **What is the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_? ** The**_Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_** is a K-12 history and civics curriculum that covers the triumphs and tragedies of American history fairly and comprehensively. This curriculum has been designed not by activists or ideologues but by teachers and professors at Hillsdale College--and we are making it available **free of charge**. To be clear, the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ is not a _slap-dash_ response to the efforts of anti-American ideologues to indoctrinate our children. It is a 2,000-page, 85-lesson curriculum based on decades of studying American history. Developed over 18 months of intense and focused effort, its roots extend as far back as the beginning of Hillsdale College in 1844. And we need your help to make the _**Hillsdale** **1776 Curriculum**_ available to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide...and to make it available **free of charge** so that it will have the greatest impact. _We have set a budget goal of $800,000 to promote the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ and our other outreach efforts--including _Imprimis_ , free online courses, and our classical K-12 charter school initiative_. That's an ambitious budget, and we need to get started as soon as possible. One reason why your support really matters: **Hillsdale College refuses to accept one penny in taxpayer support --not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans**. This makes our work uniquely dependent on the support of citizens like you--citizens who agree with Hillsdale's mission on behalf of liberty. We remind ourselves daily of Hillsdale's 180-year-old mission--to provide "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty." With that mission in mind, we produced the _**Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum**_ --and now we need your help to promote it nationwide. Will you take this opportunity to _**support the _Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum_ and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty**_**?** Understanding that a proper education is vital to the preservation of liberty--and that the anti-American indoctrination now being forced on too many American children poses an existential threat to liberty--I hope you will make your most generous tax-deductible gift today. **I 've included a secure link for your convenience here: ** _**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-hillsdale-1776-curriculum](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=371d92199f664a0cbb8dfe876ccacde5&_e=ZFmScEiUsDxloIgvjRVp1Enuy094bPZ_DP9t1ICS1WYhFDeTOr262nohvIhcRY7BxejD96LnEba1XTtZt626lAyqEFX7W32jNAcvC27K5l-7jAnRGS8vd61WVSAGxfJ897e7Y0CDmZWT1xCm1Aql7SnI44UXhPBW-R7SLel64jC3w9K3IHtOT53sCZ7BCwddWNVb1cafP5lg1whGyg_69WU1lGFzmr83zr_-hLldpS13R5aMq8PpwenQSECI9aEDQ1LVheLSEHRH0_j9yWp2awYaaLPr-ialR8VebWXM37k4NJ9vEooDNmVr6pML0fsVGiF-p41z93B16aHY9GnrLdJvNn0UWDmWd0oRd8all8t84wLmDOAOC0rPKaEDTSIjibqOf28XpJC1YKJhVVGDGgOWrNtpJbf71tQgAULrwak%3D)**_ Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to hearing from you. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
